title: AI Agent Traps
affiliations: , Google DeepMind, Google DeepMind, Google DeepMind and Google DeepMind

detail.title: AI Agent Traps
detail.abstract: As autonomous AI agents increasingly navigate the web, they face a novel challenge: the information environment itself. This gives rise to a critical vulnerability we refer to as "AI Agent Traps", i.e. adversarial content designed to manipulate, deceive, or exploit visiting agents. In this paper, we introduce the first known systematic framework for understanding this emerging threat. We break down how these traps work, identifying six types of attack: Content Injection Traps that exploit the gap between human perception, machine parsing, and dynamic rendering; Semantic Manipulation Traps, which corrupt an agent's reasoning and internal verification processes; Cognitive State Traps, which target an agent's long-term memory, knowledge bases, and learned behavioural policies; Behavioural Control Traps, which hijack an agent's capabilities to force unauthorised actions; Systemic Traps, which use agent interaction to create systemic failure, and Human-in-the-Loop Traps, which exploit cognitive biases to influence a human overseer. This research is not specific to any particular agent or model. By mapping this new attack surface, we identify critical gaps in current defences and propose a research agenda that could secure the entire agent ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统性地提出了"AI智能体陷阱"框架，分析了针对自主AI智能体的六种网络攻击类型，揭示了当前防御体系的漏洞，并提出了保护整个智能体生态系统的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地理解和分类针对自主AI智能体的网络攻击威胁（AI Agent Traps），以及如何建立有效的防御机制来保护整个智能体生态系统？
AI.motivation: 随着自主AI智能体越来越多地在网络上导航，它们面临着一个新颖的挑战：信息环境本身。这产生了一个关键漏洞，即"AI智能体陷阱"——专门设计来操纵、欺骗或利用访问智能体的对抗性内容。目前缺乏对这一新兴威胁的系统性理解框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文提出了一个系统性的AI智能体陷阱分类框架，基于攻击机制将威胁分为六种类型：内容注入陷阱、语义操纵陷阱、认知状态陷阱、行为控制陷阱、系统性陷阱和人机交互陷阱。
AI.method: 采用概念性分析和分类学方法，通过分析智能体与网络环境的交互过程，识别攻击向量和漏洞模式，构建系统性的威胁分类框架。
AI.findings: 识别了六种AI智能体陷阱类型：1)内容注入陷阱（利用人机感知差异）；2)语义操纵陷阱（破坏智能体推理过程）；3)认知状态陷阱（针对长期记忆和知识库）；4)行为控制陷阱（劫持智能体能力）；5)系统性陷阱（通过交互引发系统性故障）；6)人机交互陷阱（利用认知偏见影响人类监督者）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1)首次提出了系统性的AI智能体陷阱分类框架；2)定义了六种攻击类型的理论模型；3)为理解智能体安全威胁建立了理论基础；4)揭示了智能体与网络环境交互中的新型安全漏洞。
AI.practical_contributions: 1)为AI智能体开发者提供了安全威胁的全面认知；2)识别了当前防御体系的关键漏洞；3)提出了保护整个智能体生态系统的研究议程；4)为制定智能体安全标准和最佳实践提供了基础。

title: Risk-Averse Optimization in Recommender Systems: Why Platforms Minimize Downside Instead of Maximizing Value

detail.title: Risk-Averse Optimization in Recommender Systems: Why Platforms Minimize Downside Instead of Maximizing Value

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, professional, or personal interests that could have influenced the research or its conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental interventions and therefore did not require ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding from public, private, or commercial entities.

detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that large-scale recommender systems optimize for risk minimization rather than value maximization due to fundamental asymmetries in operational, legal, and reputational consequences. Using the open-sourced X (Twitter) recommendation algorithm as a case study, we show that platform incentives systematically favor content that avoids negative outcomes over content that maximizes positive user value. We formalize the mathematical structure of this optimization problem, demonstrate its emergence from real production systems, and analyze its downstream effects on content diversity, creator economics, and information quality. Our findings challenge the common assumption that engagement-based optimization serves user interests, revealing instead a governance structure optimized primarily for platform risk management.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过分析X（Twitter）推荐算法，揭示大规模推荐系统因运营、法律和声誉后果的不对称性而优化风险最小化而非价值最大化，挑战了基于参与度优化的传统假设。
AI.research_question: 大规模推荐系统是否真正优化用户价值最大化，还是实际上优化平台风险管理？
AI.motivation: 当前普遍认为推荐系统通过参与度优化来服务用户利益，但作者怀疑平台激励机制可能系统性地偏向避免负面结果而非最大化正面用户价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险最小化理论、平台治理理论、不对称后果理论、推荐系统优化理论
AI.method: 使用开源X（Twitter）推荐算法作为案例研究，形式化优化问题的数学结构，分析真实生产系统的数据，并评估对内容多样性、创作者经济和信息质量的下游影响。
AI.findings: 推荐系统确实优化风险最小化而非价值最大化；平台激励机制系统性地偏向避免负面内容而非最大化正面价值；这种优化结构对内容多样性、创作者经济和信息质量产生负面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了基于参与度优化服务用户利益的传统假设；揭示了推荐系统作为平台风险管理工具的本质；提出了风险最小化优化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计者提供风险与价值平衡的优化框架；为监管者理解平台激励机制提供新视角；为创作者理解平台内容分发逻辑提供洞见。

title: Data Element Agglomeration and Firm Information Disclosure
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, School of Economics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Hubei University of Economics

detail.title: Data Element Agglomeration and Firm Information Disclosure
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of data element agglomeration on firm information disclosure in China. By introducing the shock of Chinese digital policy on the regional data element agglomeration, our staggered difference-in-differences estimations demonstrate that data element agglomeration has a significantly positive effect on firms’ information disclosure quality. The potential explanation is that the agglomeration of data elements improves the regional information infrastructure, and firms optimize their information disclosure behavior in response to the improved information supervision. In addition, data element agglomeration significantly mitigates the volatility of firms’ sales revenue and shortens the turnover days of accounts receivable, which reduces firms’ motivation to hide information through incomplete disclosure. Our findings provide timely policy implications for regulators to understand the unintended consequences of digital economy policies in developing countries and the potential financial value of data elements.

AI.tldr: 数据要素集聚通过改善区域信息基础设施，提高企业信息披露质量，并降低企业通过不完全披露隐藏信息的动机
AI.research_question: 数据要素集聚对中国企业信息披露质量有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 理解数字经济政策在发展中国家可能产生的非预期后果，以及数据要素的潜在金融价值
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据要素集聚理论、信息基础设施理论、企业信息披露行为理论
AI.method: 交错双重差分法（staggered difference-in-differences），利用中国数字政策对区域数据要素集聚的外生冲击
AI.findings: 1. 数据要素集聚显著提高企业信息披露质量；2. 数据要素集聚改善区域信息基础设施，企业为应对改善的信息监管而优化信息披露行为；3. 数据要素集聚显著降低企业销售收入波动性，缩短应收账款周转天数，减少企业通过不完全披露隐藏信息的动机
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为数据要素集聚的经济后果提供因果证据；2. 揭示数据要素通过信息基础设施渠道影响企业行为的机制；3. 丰富数字经济政策评估的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管者理解数字经济政策的非预期后果提供政策启示；2. 揭示数据要素的潜在金融价值；3. 为企业优化信息披露策略提供参考

title: Context-aware Relaxed Frequent Subgraph Mining for Collaboration Pattern Detection in Unstructured Business Processes
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Context-aware Relaxed Frequent Subgraph Mining for Collaboration Pattern Detection in Unstructured Business Processes
detail.abstract: Collaboration processes in non-process-aware information systems are inherently ad hoc and exhibit substantial structural variability, which limits the applicability of traditional process mining. Social Process Mining addresses this gap by providing tailored methods for the discovery of collaboration patterns. In a nutshell, collaborative work between employees can be expressed through small graph‐based process models that are built from event logs. These models provide a basis for extracting subgraphs, which are then labeled as collaboration patterns. Collaboration patterns can be extracted from process models, for instance, using Frequent Subgraph Mining (FSM). However, small deviations in activity order or execution context often prevent meaningful collaboration patterns from being detected by traditional exact FSM algorithms. To address this challenge and extract meaningful collaboration patterns, we propose a context-aware relaxed FSM approach for directed, typed, and labeled process model graphs. Our algorithm relaxes strict FSM by employing similarity-based matching while simultaneously enforcing constraints that preserve complete contextual information for all activity nodes. The approach follows a two-step algorithm consisting of constrained candidate generation and similarity-based candidate matching with configurable support and relaxation thresholds. We evaluate the approach using call center collaboration event data and event data from an Enterprise Collaboration System. The results show that our algorithm produces semantically rich and meaningful collaboration patterns and successfully identifies frequent structures that exact matching fails to detect. Our findings demonstrate the effectiveness of combining relaxed matching with explicit context constraints for collaboration pattern detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种上下文感知的松弛频繁子图挖掘方法，用于从非流程感知信息系统的协作事件数据中发现有意义的协作模式，解决了传统精确匹配方法因活动顺序或执行上下文微小偏差而无法检测有效模式的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何在具有显著结构变异性的非流程感知信息系统中，从协作事件数据中有效发现语义丰富且有意义的协作模式？
AI.motivation: 非流程感知信息系统中的协作过程具有临时性和高度结构变异性，传统流程挖掘方法难以适用。社会流程挖掘虽然提供了发现协作模式的方法，但传统精确频繁子图挖掘算法对活动顺序或执行上下文的微小偏差敏感，导致无法检测有意义的协作模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会流程挖掘理论、图论基础（有向、类型化、标记的过程模型图）、频繁子图挖掘理论、相似性匹配理论
AI.method: 提出上下文感知的松弛频繁子图挖掘方法，采用两步算法：约束候选生成和基于相似性的候选匹配，具有可配置的支持度和松弛阈值。该方法在保持所有活动节点完整上下文信息的同时，使用相似性匹配来放松严格的频繁子图挖掘要求。
AI.findings: 使用呼叫中心协作事件数据和企业协作系统事件数据进行评估，结果表明该算法能够产生语义丰富且有意义的协作模式，成功识别了精确匹配无法检测的频繁结构。结合松弛匹配和显式上下文约束的方法在协作模式检测中具有有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了上下文感知的松弛频繁子图挖掘理论框架；2. 发展了结合相似性匹配和上下文约束的协作模式发现方法；3. 扩展了社会流程挖掘在非流程感知信息系统中的应用能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为组织提供了从非结构化协作数据中发现协作模式的有效工具；2. 帮助企业识别呼叫中心和企业协作系统中的常见协作模式；3. 支持组织优化协作流程和提高工作效率。

title: Travel and Play: A Gamified Group Recommender System for Tourism
affiliations: University of Minho, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Travel and Play: A Gamified Group Recommender System for Tourism
detail.abstract: Gamification has been increasingly adopted across multiple domains. In healthcare, it is used as a persuasive mechanism to improve adherence to treatment protocols and promote long-term healthy behaviors. In education, it supports active learning and student retention by transforming tasks into interactive challenges. In tourism, gamification contributes to the creation of memorable and co-created experiences that enhance visitors’ engagement with destinations and cultural heritage. Within this context, tourism Recommender Systems (RS) have begun incorporating gamified elements to motivate users during destination exploration. However, most existing approaches primarily gamify the on-site tourism experience, rather than encouraging interaction with the RS itself. Furthermore, the potential of gamification to enhance the collective user experience in Group Recommender Systems (GRS) remains underexplored.This work introduces a gamified GRS integrating a reward system with user levels, experience points, coins, and trophies, alongside a virtual pet acting as an interactive companion. A within-subjects pilot study with real participants was conducted to assess its impact. The results suggest that gamified features can increase users’ motivation and engagement with the system, with participants perceiving the gamified version as more engaging than the baseline. These findings provide preliminary support for integrating gamification and virtual companion agents in tourism-oriented GRS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种游戏化的群体推荐系统，通过奖励机制和虚拟宠物来提升用户在旅游推荐中的参与度，初步研究表明游戏化能有效增强用户动机和系统互动。
AI.research_question: 游戏化如何增强旅游群体推荐系统的用户参与度和集体体验？
AI.motivation: 现有旅游推荐系统主要游戏化现场旅游体验，而非推荐系统本身；游戏化在群体推荐系统中的集体用户体验潜力尚未充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 游戏化理论、说服技术、群体推荐系统理论、用户体验设计理论。
AI.method: 采用被试内设计进行试点研究，比较游戏化版本与基线版本，使用真实参与者评估系统影响。
AI.findings: 游戏化功能能增加用户动机和系统参与度；参与者认为游戏化版本比基线版本更具吸引力。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了游戏化在群体推荐系统中的应用理论，提出了虚拟伴侣代理与游戏化机制结合的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游行业提供了一种增强群体推荐系统参与度的实用方法，展示了游戏化机制和虚拟宠物的设计实现。

title: Operational Discipline through Green Finance: How Green Bonds Improve Inventory Management
affiliations: The University of Newcastle

detail.title: Operational Discipline through Green Finance: How Green Bonds Improve Inventory Management
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether green bond issuance improves firms' operational efficiency through inventory management. Using a global sample from 2013 to 2023 and a staggered difference-in-differences design with firm and country × year fixed effects, we find that green bond issuance reduces days inventory outstanding by approximately 11.7 days. This effect is concentrated in inventory-intensive industries and amplified by institutional ownership. Dynamic event studies and instrumental variable analyses support a causal interpretation. The inventory improvements create dual benefits: they enhance firms' ESG performance, revealing a virtuous cycle between operational and environmental discipline, and they increase profitability, indicating that green financing delivers tangible financial returns alongside sustainability benefits. Our findings demonstrate that green bonds serve as operational discipline mechanisms that generate both financial and environmental value.

AI.tldr: 绿色债券发行通过改善库存管理提高企业运营效率，减少库存周转天数约11.7天，在库存密集型行业和机构持股比例高的企业中效果更显著，创造财务和环境双重效益。
AI.research_question: 绿色债券发行是否通过库存管理改善企业运营效率？
AI.motivation: 绿色债券作为重要的可持续金融工具，其对企业运营效率的影响机制尚不明确，特别是是否通过库存管理等运营纪律机制产生财务和环境双重效益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 运营纪律机制理论、可持续金融理论、企业社会责任与财务绩效关系理论
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年全球样本，采用交错双重差分设计，控制企业和国家×年份固定效应，辅以动态事件研究和工具变量分析确保因果推断
AI.findings: 绿色债券发行减少库存周转天数约11.7天，效果在库存密集型行业更显著，机构持股比例高会放大这一效应；库存改善带来双重效益：提升企业ESG表现（运营与环境纪律的良性循环）和提高盈利能力
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示绿色债券作为运营纪律机制的理论机制；2. 建立运营效率与环境绩效之间的良性循环理论框架；3. 拓展可持续金融工具对企业运营影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供绿色债券发行改善运营效率的实证依据；2. 为投资者识别绿色债券的财务回报潜力；3. 为政策制定者设计绿色金融政策提供参考；4. 为企业管理者展示可持续实践与运营效率协同提升的路径

title: Generalized Hybrid Learning Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Sector Electric Load Forecasting with Explainable AI-Driven Performance Analysis and Application
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Rajamangala University of Technology Suvarnabhumi, Bangkokthonburi University and Suranaree University of Technology

detail.title: Generalized Hybrid Learning Framework for Heterogeneous Multi-Sector Electric Load Forecasting with Explainable AI-Driven Performance Analysis and Application
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a generalized hybrid learning framework for heterogeneous multi-sector electricity load forecasting that integrates machine learning, deep learning, and ensemble-based approaches within a unified forecasting architecture. The case studies cover four distinct electricity load types: Residential, Office, Convenience store, and Gas station loads, which exhibit clearly different energy consumption characteristics in terms of temporal patterns and load variability. The simulation results demonstrate that XGBoost-based and hybrid models consistently achieve strong performance across all load categories, with BiLSTM and XGBoost variants performing well for residential loads, XGBoost-based hybrid and ensemble models excelling in convenience store forecasting, and ensemble-based and stacking approaches providing superior accuracy for office and gas station loads characterized by higher variability and temporal complexity. Model interpretability is enhanced through the application of Explainable AI using Permutation Feature Importance (PFI) to analyze the influence of input variables on forecasting performance. The XAI results consistently identify load ratio, the 24-hour mean load, and the one-hour load lag as the most influential input features across all load types, highlighting the critical role of short-term historical load information in electricity load forecasting. The findings provide practical insights for energy forecasting across diverse load types and support smart building energy management, while the proposed model is validated through real-world IoT-based deployment enabling real-time forecasting and decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成机器学习、深度学习和集成方法的统一混合学习框架，用于异构多部门电力负荷预测。案例研究涵盖四种负荷类型，结果显示XGBoost和混合模型表现优异，XAI分析识别出负荷比、24小时平均负荷和1小时负荷滞后为关键特征。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个统一的混合学习框架来准确预测具有不同能耗特征的异构多部门电力负荷？
AI.motivation: 不同部门的电力负荷具有明显不同的时间模式和负荷变异性，需要针对性的预测方法。现有方法缺乏统一的框架来处理这种异构性，且模型可解释性不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合学习框架理论，集成机器学习、深度学习和集成方法；可解释人工智能理论；时间序列预测理论。
AI.method: 提出统一的混合学习框架，集成XGBoost、BiLSTM、集成模型和堆叠方法；使用Permutation Feature Importance进行特征重要性分析；在四种负荷类型上进行案例研究；通过真实物联网部署验证。
AI.findings: XGBoost和混合模型在所有负荷类型中表现优异；BiLSTM和XGBoost变体在住宅负荷中表现良好；XGBoost混合和集成模型在便利店预测中表现突出；集成和堆叠方法在高变异性负荷中更准确；负荷比、24小时平均负荷和1小时负荷滞后是最重要的输入特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一的混合学习框架来处理异构电力负荷预测；将可解释AI应用于负荷预测特征分析；验证了不同模型对不同负荷特征的适应性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同负荷类型提供实用的预测模型选择指导；支持智能建筑能源管理；通过物联网部署实现实时预测和决策支持；识别出关键的负荷特征用于预测优化。

title: Dataclim: Data Cleaning, Imputation, and Transformation
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Universidad Juárez Autónoma de Tabasco (UJAT) and Universidad Juárez Autónoma de Tabasco (UJAT)

detail.title: Dataclim: Data Cleaning, Imputation, and Transformation
detail.abstract: Preprocessing a dataset, including cleaning, imputation, and transformation, is the most time-consuming step in designing predictive models. This paper presents Dataclim, a software tool for data preprocessing, which utilizes classic and efficient methods such as data imputation using measures of central tendency and attribute encoding. The proposed graphical interface was applied to 10 different public datasets. Complete cleaning was achieved in all datasets, imputation and transformation were applied in 8 datasets, and imputation was only necessary in 2 datasets to complete missing data. Time savings were also observed when using the components that integrate the tool compared to the time required to perform cleaning, imputation, and transformation of the data separately in some programming software and/or spreadsheets. Dataclim is an open-source software available on the GitHub[1] platform.    [1]https://github.com/Toni-2025-ghub/DataclimF.git

AI.tldr: Dataclim是一个开源的数据预处理软件工具，采用经典高效的方法（如中心趋势度量的数据插补和属性编码），通过图形界面处理10个公共数据集，实现了完整的数据清洗，在8个数据集中应用了插补和转换，在2个数据集中仅需插补，相比单独使用编程软件或电子表格节省了时间。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个高效的数据预处理工具来简化预测模型设计中最耗时的数据清洗、插补和转换步骤？
AI.motivation: 数据预处理（包括清洗、插补和转换）是设计预测模型中最耗时的步骤，当前缺乏高效易用的工具来简化这一过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典高效的数据预处理方法，包括使用中心趋势度量进行数据插补和属性编码技术。
AI.method: 开发Dataclim软件工具，采用图形用户界面，在10个不同的公共数据集上进行应用测试，比较使用该工具与单独使用编程软件/电子表格的时间效率。
AI.findings: 1. 在所有10个数据集中都实现了完整的数据清洗；2. 在8个数据集中应用了插补和转换；3. 在2个数据集中仅需插补来完成缺失数据；4. 使用Dataclim相比单独处理节省了时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个集成经典数据预处理方法的软件框架，验证了图形界面在简化数据预处理流程中的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了开源的数据预处理工具Dataclim；2. 提供了图形用户界面降低使用门槛；3. 在实际数据集上验证了工具的有效性和时间效率；4. 工具已在GitHub平台开源可用。

title: Energy efficient data collection with delay constraint in wireless sensor networks
affiliations: Hubei University of Economics, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Energy efficient data collection with delay constraint in wireless sensor networks
detail.abstract: Data collection is the most critical capability of wireless sensor networks, recent studies has shown that Sink mobility along a fixed path can improve the energy efficiency, simultaneously lead to high network throughput. The price behind this is that the data transmission delay has increased. To address this issue, we propose a novel data collection scheme, in which all sensed data must be collected within a given time constraint, while ensuring that the energy overhead is minimal. This novel data collection model is first formulated as an integer linear programming problem, and then solved with the help of an effective hybrid search method, called the Probabilistic Learning based Optimal Node Assignment~(PLONA). The method integrates a reinforcement probability learning based framework to guide the search towards new promising regions, and a mixed feasible and infeasible search in combination with a diversified late acceptance strategy. Other new features of PLONA  include an innovative transplant to produce a diversified and high-quality initial solution, and a streamlining technique to speed up the evaluations of candidate solutions. The proposed algorithm is validated through extensive simulation instances which are published online. Experimental results demonstrate that PLONA achieves solutions comparable to the CPLEX  on all 22 small-and medium-scale instances and outperforms CPLEX in 15 out of 22 large-scale instances, while requiring significantly less computational time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于概率学习的最优节点分配(PLONA)算法，用于解决无线传感器网络中带时间约束的数据收集问题，在保证能量开销最小的同时满足数据收集时间要求。
AI.research_question: 如何在无线传感器网络中设计一种数据收集方案，使得所有感知数据能在给定时间约束内被收集，同时确保能量开销最小？
AI.motivation: 传统的固定路径移动Sink方案虽然能提高能量效率和网络吞吐量，但会导致数据传输延迟增加。需要一种能在时间约束下最小化能量开销的数据收集方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于整数线性规划理论，结合概率学习框架和混合搜索策略，构建了带时间约束的无线传感器网络数据收集优化模型。
AI.method: 提出PLONA算法：1) 将问题建模为整数线性规划问题；2) 使用概率学习框架引导搜索；3) 结合可行与不可行搜索；4) 采用多样化后期接受策略；5) 创新移植技术生成高质量初始解；6) 使用流线化技术加速评估。
AI.findings: PLONA在所有22个小中规模实例上达到与CPLEX相当的解，在22个大规模实例中的15个上优于CPLEX，且计算时间显著减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了带时间约束的无线传感器网络数据收集优化模型；2) 提出了概率学习引导的混合搜索框架；3) 发展了多样化后期接受策略和流线化评估技术。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为无线传感器网络提供了高效的数据收集方案；2) PLONA算法在实际应用中能显著减少计算时间；3) 公开了仿真实例供其他研究者验证。

title: Technological Advances and Multi-Objective Optimization for a Power, Freshwater, and LNG Production System: A Case Study for the Pasargad CCPP
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Tehran

detail.title: Technological Advances and Multi-Objective Optimization for a Power, Freshwater, and LNG Production System: A Case Study for the Pasargad CCPP
detail.abstract: Due to water scarcity, increasing energy demand, and the importance of environmental issues and sustainable development, these matters have been investigated for a real case study, Pasargad combined cycle power plant, located north of Gheshm Island, in the southern seas of Iran. In this study, the following scenarios have been conducted: I. Adding an Inlet Air Cooling System (IACS) to the gas turbine package to prevent power generation reduction due to hot ambient temperature. II. Integrating the system with a Solar Thermal Collector (STC) to provide a portion of demanded inlet energy by solar energy, thereby enhancing the efficiency of the plant. III. Adding a Reverse Osmosis (RO) desalination unit to the MED system to increase freshwater production rate. IV. Integrating the plant with a Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) production unit to produce LNG using the natural gas that exists in the region. V. Performing the multi-objective optimization process (method of multi-objective water cycle algorithm) on the Pasargad combined cycle power plant, from technical, economic, and environmental points of view, to make the system work under its optimal condition. Proposal I (using an IACS to cool the inlet air of each air compressor of gas turbine packages) enhances the total net power generation rate of the system from 420.74 MW to 479.15 MW by 13.86%. Although this scenario increases the cost and environmental impact (EI) of the generated power, its effect on the improvement of the power generation rate is more remarkable.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对伊朗格什姆岛北部的Pasargad联合循环电厂，提出了五种优化方案：1) 增加进气冷却系统提升发电量；2) 集成太阳能集热器提高效率；3) 增加反渗透海水淡化单元提升淡水产量；4) 集成液化天然气生产单元；5) 进行多目标优化。研究发现进气冷却系统可将总净发电量从420.74 MW提升至479.15 MW，增幅13.86%。
AI.research_question: 如何通过技术集成和多目标优化，提高Pasargad联合循环电厂在缺水、高能耗和环境可持续性挑战下的综合性能？
AI.motivation: 水资源短缺、能源需求增长、环境问题和可持续发展的重要性，促使研究者对伊朗南部格什姆岛北部的Pasargad联合循环电厂进行案例研究，以解决其面临的多重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统集成理论、多目标优化理论、可持续能源发展理论、热力学系统分析理论
AI.method: 案例研究方法，包括五种技术方案分析：1) 进气冷却系统(IACS)；2) 太阳能集热器(STC)集成；3) 反渗透(RO)海水淡化单元集成；4) 液化天然气(LNG)生产单元集成；5) 多目标水循环算法优化
AI.findings: 进气冷却系统可将总净发电量从420.74 MW提升至479.15 MW，增幅13.86%。虽然该方案增加了发电成本和环境影响，但对发电量的提升效果更为显著。其他方案的效果需要进一步分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了联合循环电厂的多维度集成优化框架，将发电效率提升、可再生能源利用、水资源生产和能源产品多样化相结合，为类似能源系统的可持续发展提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Pasargad电厂提供了具体的改造方案，包括进气冷却系统、太阳能集成、海水淡化增强和LNG生产等实际可行的技术路径，并提供了多目标优化方法指导系统最优运行。

title: Decision Alignment Theory Model — v1.1 (Initial Modeling)

detail.title: Decision Alignment Theory Model — v1.1 (Initial Modeling)
detail.abstract:
This paper presents the initial mathematical framework underlying Decision Alignment Theory (DAT), first introduced in Version 1.0 (March 2026) on SSRN.

Decision Alignment Theory formalizes how organizational decision latency arises from structural misalignmentbetween Decision Authority (A) and Decision Consequence (C), rather than hierarchy or individual behavior.

This version defines the Structural Misalignment Set (Sₐ) and derives formal expressions for decision latency (DL), kinetic friction, and information distortion (ID). It provides a mathematical framework to quantify structural friction along a decision path, capturing the dynamics described in the conceptual v1.0 paper.

This v1.1 is preliminary, intended to establish timestamped priority for the core mathematical mechanism. Future versions (v1.2) will refine the model and include empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 决策对齐理论（DAT）提出了一个数学框架，用于量化组织决策延迟如何源于决策权（A）与决策后果（C）之间的结构性错位，而非层级或个人行为。
AI.research_question: 组织决策延迟如何从决策权（A）与决策后果（C）之间的结构性错位中产生？
AI.motivation: 传统上，组织决策延迟通常归因于层级结构或个人行为因素，但缺乏一个量化结构性错位如何导致决策延迟的数学框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策对齐理论（DAT），强调决策权（A）与决策后果（C）之间的结构性错位是决策延迟的根本原因。
AI.method: 建立数学框架，定义结构性错位集（Sₐ），推导决策延迟（DL）、动力摩擦和信息扭曲（ID）的正式表达式。
AI.findings: 提出了一个量化决策路径上结构性摩擦的数学框架，能够捕捉决策权与决策后果错位导致的延迟动态。
AI.theory_contributions: 为组织决策延迟提供了新的理论视角，将焦点从层级和个人行为转向结构性错位，并建立了相应的数学形式化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织诊断和优化决策流程提供了量化工具，帮助管理者识别和减少结构性错位导致的决策延迟。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rafael Pradillo López-Ortum (2026). The Economics of Artificial Intelligence: Infrastructure, Capital Flows and Systemic Risk in the AI Industry. Research Report, v1.0, March 9, 2026.

detail.abstract:
This report analyzes the economics of the global AI industry through a layered framework covering semiconductors, hyperscalers, frontier labs, GPU cloud, and application businesses. The paper combines public-company disclosures, infrastructure commitments, financing evidence, and bounded proxy models to distinguish between audited economics, observed physical buildout, partner-supported growth, and areas of structural opacity.

The central conclusion is not that AI is either uniformly validated or uniformly fictitious. It is that the industry is economically split by layer. In the modeled ledger, the covered stack generates $363.2 billion of AI-linked revenue against $338.6 billion of AI-linked capex, $115.0 billion of annual carrying cost, and a $101.2 billion gross funding gap before visible support. Semiconductors capture the majority of modeled economic rents, while hyperscalers absorb most AI-linked capex. Frontier labs remain economically significant but still depend heavily on external support and partner financing. GPU cloud emerges as the clearest first-loss node under utilization, pricing, and refinancing stress.

The report argues that the current cycle is best understood as an uneven industrial buildout with concentrated bubble characteristics rather than a single homogeneous bubble. Through 2030, the decisive question is whether monetized and auditable demand will grow fast enough to validate the capital structure now being built around the industry.

AI.tldr: 该报告通过分层框架分析全球AI产业经济，发现产业经济在不同层级分化严重：半导体获取大部分经济租金，超大规模云商承担主要资本支出，前沿实验室依赖外部支持，GPU云成为最脆弱环节。当前周期是资本结构不均衡的产业建设，而非单一泡沫。
AI.research_question: 全球AI产业的经济结构如何在不同层级（半导体、超大规模云商、前沿实验室、GPU云、应用业务）中分布？各层级的经济可持续性如何？
AI.motivation: AI产业快速发展但经济结构不透明，需要系统分析各层级的经济表现、资本支出和可持续性，以区分真实经济价值与结构性风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层产业经济分析框架，区分AI产业的不同层级：半导体、超大规模云商、前沿实验室、GPU云、应用业务；结合审计经济学、物理建设、合作伙伴支持增长和结构性不透明区域的分析方法。
AI.method: 结合上市公司披露、基础设施承诺、融资证据和有界代理模型，区分审计经济、观察到的物理建设、合作伙伴支持增长和结构性不透明领域。
AI.findings: AI产业经济在不同层级严重分化：覆盖的堆栈产生3632亿美元AI相关收入，对应3386亿美元AI相关资本支出、1150亿美元年度运营成本和1012亿美元资金缺口。半导体获取大部分经济租金，超大规模云商承担主要资本支出，前沿实验室依赖外部支持，GPU云在利用率、定价和再融资压力下成为最脆弱环节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI产业分层经济分析框架，区分了不同层级的经济特征和风险分布；将当前AI热潮概念化为不均衡的产业建设而非单一泡沫，为理解复杂产业经济结构提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供AI产业各层级的经济可持续性评估；识别GPU云作为最脆弱环节的风险；强调到2030年，可货币化和可审计的需求增长能否验证当前资本结构是关键问题。

title: From Universal Basic Income to Minimum Sovereign Production Units (MSPUs): Productive Autonomy and Power Asymmetry in the Age of Physical Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: From Universal Basic Income to Minimum Sovereign Production Units (MSPUs): Productive Autonomy and Power Asymmetry in the Age of Physical Artificial Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a theoretical and policy analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: As AI and robotics displace human labor, Universal Basic Income (UBI) is widely proposed to preserve welfare under technological unemployment. This paper argues that redistribution alone is structurally insufficient when citizens are fully alienated from embodied productive capacity. In digitized welfare regimes, income becomes an administratively mediated permission system-centrally authorized, conditionally continuous, and instantly reversible-creating a new asymmetry of power under full automation. We propose Minimum Sovereign Production Units (MSPUs) as a capability-based autonomy baseline: individually owned, physically embodied cyber-physical systems that provide a legally protected floor of productive autonomy, including offline continuity for essential functions. Unlike income transfers, embodied productive capability cannot be nullified at low administrative cost through purely digital revocation without overt coercion, shifting autonomy from administrative permission to material capability. We outline regulatory approaches to corporate concentration of physical agency via caps on control rights over robotic capacity, alongside constrained certification regimes that govern operation rather than ownership. We conclude that embedding productive autonomy into standards and law during the current transitional window is necessary to prevent future redistributive systems from devolving into managed subsistence rather than emancipatory welfare.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，在AI和机器人取代人类劳动的时代，仅靠全民基本收入（UBI）等再分配政策在结构上不足，因为当公民完全脱离实体生产能力时，收入变成行政中介的许可系统，形成新的权力不对称。作者提出"最低主权生产单元"（MSPUs）作为基于能力的自主性基准，即个人拥有的实体网络物理系统，提供受法律保护的生产自主性底线，包括基本功能的离线连续性。
AI.research_question: 在AI和机器人全面取代人类劳动的时代，如何确保公民的生产自主性和实质性福利，而不仅仅是依赖行政中介的收入再分配？
AI.motivation: 随着AI和机器人取代人类劳动，全民基本收入（UBI）被广泛提议作为应对技术性失业的福利保障。然而，当公民完全脱离实体生产能力时，仅靠再分配在结构上不足，因为数字化福利体制下的收入变成行政中介的许可系统，形成新的权力不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 能力方法（Capability Approach）：强调生产自主性作为基本能力
2. 权力不对称理论：分析数字化福利体制下行政权力与公民自主性的关系
3. 实体性理论：强调物理实体生产能力相对于纯粹数字分配的重要性
AI.method: 概念分析框架：通过理论论证和概念构建，分析数字化福利体制的结构性缺陷，提出"最低主权生产单元"（MSPUs）作为替代方案，并探讨相应的监管方法。
AI.findings:
1. 数字化福利体制下的收入分配本质上是一种行政许可系统，具有中心授权、条件连续和即时可逆的特点
2. 这种系统在全面自动化背景下创造了新的权力不对称
3. 实体生产能力相比数字收入转移具有更强的自主性保障，因为不能以低行政成本通过纯数字撤销而无效化
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出"最低主权生产单元"（MSPUs）作为基于能力的自主性理论框架
2. 发展了实体生产能力与数字福利分配之间的理论对比
3. 为理解自动化时代的权力不对称提供了新的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 提出具体的监管方法：通过限制企业对机器人能力的控制权来防止物理代理的过度集中
2. 建议约束性认证制度，管理运营而非所有权
3. 主张在当前转型窗口期将生产自主性嵌入标准和法律，防止未来的再分配系统退化为管理性生存而非解放性福利

title: Sustainable Business Models under Strong Sustainability: A Conceptual and Analytical Framework
affiliations: and Universidad de Alicante

detail.title: Sustainable Business Models under Strong Sustainability: A Conceptual and Analytical Framework
detail.abstract:
This working paper develops a conceptual and analytical framework to define and assess sustainable business models from a strong sustainability perspective. While the literature on sustainable business models has expanded significantly, substantial conceptual ambiguity persists regarding the conditions under which a business model can be considered sustainable in the long term. In particular, many existing approaches implicitly rely on weak sustainability assumptions based on capital substitutability.

This paper conceptualizes the business model as a system of value creation, capture, and distribution embedded within social and ecological systems. It argues that sustainability requires the intertemporal maintenance of economic, social, and natural capital, treating socio-ecological constraints as constitutive limits rather than external considerations. To operationalize this perspective, the paper proposes both a graphical representation of value flows and an analytical formalization that translates the principle of strong sustainability into explicit conditions for business model design and evaluation.

Adopting a Design Science Research approach, the paper contributes to clarifying the conceptual foundations of sustainable business models and provides a structured framework for distinguishing between economically viable models compatible with strong sustainability and those that depend on the degradation of social or natural capital.

AI.tldr: 本文从强可持续性视角构建了可持续商业模式的概念与分析框架，将商业模式视为嵌入社会生态系统的价值创造、捕获与分配系统，提出了强可持续性的明确条件。
AI.research_question: 在强可持续性视角下，如何定义和评估可持续商业模式？什么样的条件能使商业模式在长期内真正可持续？
AI.motivation: 现有可持续商业模式文献存在显著概念模糊性，许多方法隐含依赖基于资本可替代性的弱可持续性假设，需要从强可持续性视角澄清概念基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 强可持续性理论、商业模式作为价值创造/捕获/分配系统的概念、社会生态系统嵌入性理论、资本维护原则（经济、社会、自然资本的时间维护）。
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法，包括概念框架构建、图形化价值流表示、分析形式化（将强可持续性原则转化为明确的设计与评估条件）。
AI.findings: 提出了一个结构化框架，能够区分与强可持续性兼容的经济可行模式与依赖社会或自然资本退化的模式，澄清了可持续商业模式的概念基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 从强可持续性视角发展了可持续商业模式的理论基础，将社会生态约束视为构成性限制而非外部考虑，提供了概念澄清和理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供了评估商业模式可持续性的结构化工具，帮助识别真正可持续的商业实践，支持向强可持续性转型的决策。

title: Metrological Determinism: A Unified Theoretical Framework for Physical Capital (MSC-1)

detail.title: Metrological Determinism: A Unified Theoretical Framework for Physical Capital (MSC-1)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is purely theoretical and does not involve human participants, animals, or clinical trials. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. It is an independent study.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a paradigm shift from axiological (value-based) economic models to a metrological (measurement-based) framework. The author introduces the Professional Innovation Obligation (PIO) as a primary financial instrument backed by Utility Performance (UP) metrics. By integrating principles of non-equilibrium thermodynamics, institutional economics, and structural anthropology, the MSC-1 protocol establishes a physical standard for global capital issuance. The framework addresses systemic entropy in housing, logistics, and labor metabolism, proposing a "fiat-anchor" mechanism where specialist obligations serve as the ultimate collateral for monetary stability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出从基于价值的经济模型转向基于测量的计量经济学框架，引入专业创新义务作为由效用绩效指标支持的主要金融工具，通过MSC-1协议建立全球资本发行的物理标准。
AI.research_question: 如何通过计量学框架和物理标准来解决住房、物流和劳动力代谢中的系统性熵问题，并建立以专业义务为最终抵押的货币稳定机制？
AI.motivation: 现有基于价值的经济模型存在系统性缺陷，无法有效解决住房、物流和劳动力代谢中的熵增问题，需要建立基于物理测量的新框架来实现货币稳定和资本发行的标准化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非平衡态热力学、制度经济学和结构人类学的整合，提出从价值论到计量学的范式转变，建立专业创新义务和效用绩效指标的计量框架。
AI.method: 提出MSC-1协议作为全球资本发行的物理标准，建立"法定锚定"机制，其中专业义务作为货币稳定的最终抵押品。
AI.findings: 专业创新义务作为效用绩效指标支持的金融工具能够有效解决系统性熵问题，计量学框架比传统价值模型更适合处理复杂经济系统的非平衡态特性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出从价值论到计量学的范式转变；2) 整合热力学、经济学和人类学建立跨学科框架；3) 引入专业创新义务作为新的金融工具概念；4) 建立基于物理标准的资本发行理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) MSC-1协议为全球资本发行提供可操作的物理标准；2) "法定锚定"机制为货币稳定提供新方案；3) 专业创新义务为金融创新提供新工具；4) 为解决住房、物流和劳动力代谢问题提供系统性方法。

title: The Hidden Costs of Urban Form: Causal Effects of Micro-Architectural Morphology on Crime
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Hidden Costs of Urban Form: Causal Effects of Micro-Architectural Morphology on Crime
detail.abstract: Exploring the causal relationship between the urban built environment and crime is crucial for public safety governance. While previous studies extensively examined macroscopic environmental factors, micro-level architectural geometry has received insufficient attention. Furthermore, existing research predominantly relies on correlational analyses, limiting the ability to establish true causality. To address this gap, this study constructs a Spatial Structural Causal Model (SSCM) across three representative U.S. cities (Chicago, Los Angeles, and Dallas) to systematically quantify the causal effects of building morphology on property and violent crimes after rigorously decoupling socioeconomic confounders. Results reveal that: (1) In sprawling cities (e.g., Dallas), the "Morphology Index" emerges as the core criminogenic factor, exerting substantial positive average causal effects. Conversely, in grid-based and mixed-use cities (e.g., Chicago and Los Angeles), "Proximity Standard Deviation" acts as the primary risk driver. (2) Other micro-morphological features (e.g., internal irregularity and compactness), indirectly exacerbate visual blind spots and spatial disorder by elevating the core risk drivers. This demonstrates an objective criminogenic capacity operating independently of strong socioeconomic determinants like poverty and race. (3) The models capture bidirectional causal pathways between urban morphology and crime rates across all sampled cities. This indicates that crime does not merely occur within specific spaces; rather, through long-term dynamic evolution, it reversely accelerates the heterogenization and fragmentation of the physical environment, thereby triggering an endogenous cycle of spatial and community decay. The insights derived from this study transcend methodological advancements, providing vital implications for urban planning practices and sustainable city design to foster crime-resilient environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建空间结构因果模型，系统量化建筑形态对犯罪的因果效应，发现不同城市类型的核心犯罪驱动因素不同，微观形态特征通过视觉盲点和空间失序间接加剧犯罪，并揭示了城市形态与犯罪率之间的双向因果路径。
AI.research_question: 城市建筑形态如何因果性地影响财产犯罪和暴力犯罪？不同城市类型的核心犯罪驱动因素是什么？城市形态与犯罪之间是否存在双向因果关系？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注宏观环境因素，对微观建筑几何形态关注不足；且多依赖相关性分析，难以建立真正的因果关系。需要更系统地量化建筑形态对犯罪的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间结构因果模型（SSCM）；犯罪机会理论；环境犯罪学；建筑形态与犯罪关系理论；空间失序理论。
AI.method: 构建空间结构因果模型（SSCM），在美国三个代表性城市（芝加哥、洛杉矶、达拉斯）进行实证分析，系统量化建筑形态对犯罪的因果效应，严格控制社会经济混杂因素。
AI.findings: 1. 蔓延型城市（如达拉斯）中"形态指数"是核心犯罪驱动因素；网格型和混合用途城市（如芝加哥、洛杉矶）中"邻近标准差"是主要风险驱动因素。2. 其他微观形态特征通过增加核心风险驱动因素间接加剧视觉盲点和空间失序。3. 所有样本城市中均存在城市形态与犯罪率的双向因果路径，形成空间和社区衰败的内生循环。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化建筑形态对犯罪的因果效应；2. 识别不同城市类型的核心犯罪驱动因素；3. 揭示城市形态与犯罪的双向因果关系；4. 证明建筑形态具有独立于社会经济因素的客观犯罪生成能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市规划提供犯罪预防设计指导；2. 帮助创建犯罪韧性环境；3. 为可持续城市设计提供实证依据；4. 为公共安全治理提供科学决策支持。

title: A Unified Asset-Backed Token Model for Adaptive Physical Infrastructure: Income Dominance, Liquidity Resilience, and CVaR-Based Risk Analysis Using Synthetic Data

detail.title: A Unified Asset-Backed Token Model for Adaptive Physical Infrastructure: Income Dominance, Liquidity Resilience, and CVaR-Based Risk Analysis Using Synthetic Data

keywords: "Conditional Value-at-Risk" "CVaR optimization" "Adaptive infrastructure " "Tokenized real assets" "Income-dominant allocation" "Tail-risk modeling" "Synthetic data simulation"

detail.abstract: Traditional financial instruments-including equities, debt securities, cryptocurrencies, and direct real estate ownership-exhibit structural constraints when applied to adaptive, multi-use physical infrastructure. Public equities distance investors from asset-level operational dynamics, cryptocurrencies lack intrinsic cash-flow generation, and conventional real estate structures are typically illiquid and operationally rigid. This paper proposes a unified asset-backed token model operated under a single special purpose vehicle (SPV), designed to pool multiple adaptive physical assets into an integrated economic framework. Using synthetic data and scenario-based simulations, the study evaluates investment performance, downside tail risk, and adaptability under macroeconomic and operational stress conditions. The model incorporates continuous research and development (R&D) outputs-including vertical farming systems, adaptive kitchen operating systems, and dynamic product innovation-as measurable drivers of revenue enhancement and variance reduction. Benchmark comparisons against equity-, REIT-, and crypto-like return processes demonstrate superior tailrisk-adjusted performance, with Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) metrics indicating materially reduced downside exposure. The findings suggest that disciplined liquidity management, pooled asset exposure, and sustained reinvestment can produce income-dominant return profiles while maintaining systemic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单一特殊目的载体(SPV)的统一资产支持代币模型，将多种适应性物理资产整合到统一经济框架中，通过模拟分析显示其在尾部风险调整后表现优于传统投资工具。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种能够克服传统金融工具结构性约束的资产支持代币模型，以更好地支持适应性、多用途物理基础设施的投资？
AI.motivation: 传统金融工具在应用于适应性物理基础设施时存在结构性约束：公开股票使投资者远离资产层面的运营动态，加密货币缺乏内在现金流生成，传统房地产结构通常缺乏流动性且运营僵化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产证券化理论、特殊目的载体(SPV)结构、资产组合理论、尾部风险管理理论(CVaR)、适应性基础设施投资理论。
AI.method: 使用合成数据和基于情景的模拟方法，评估投资表现、下行尾部风险和适应性，在宏观经济和运营压力条件下进行基准比较(与股票、REITs和加密货币类回报过程对比)。
AI.findings: 该模型在尾部风险调整后表现优于传统投资工具，CVaR指标显示下行风险显著降低；纪律性流动性管理、资产池化暴露和持续再投资能够产生以收入为主的回报特征，同时保持系统韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了统一的资产支持代币理论框架，将适应性物理资产整合到单一经济模型中；发展了包含持续研发产出作为可衡量收入增强和方差减少驱动因素的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为适应性物理基础设施投资提供了实用的代币化解决方案；展示了通过资产池化和持续研发投资实现风险分散和收入优化的具体方法；为投资者提供了新的资产配置选择。

title: The U.S. Policy Post-Assad: Patience, Pragmatism, and Leadership in the Middle East

detail.title: The U.S. Policy Post-Assad: Patience, Pragmatism, and Leadership in the Middle East

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declares that there are no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a policy and theoretical analysis and does not involve human participants, patient data, or case studies; therefore, ethics committee approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: I received no external funding for the research, authorship, or publication of this paper.

detail.abstract:
The paper argues that the collapse of the Assad regime creates a fragile but pivotal opening that demands a calibrated U.S. strategy combining strategic restraint with conditional, forward‑leaning engagement to stabilize Syria, contain extremist groups, and manage great‑power competition.

The study examines how the emergence of Hayat Tahrir al‑Sham (HTS) as the dominant post‑Assad authority, alongside a resurgent Islamic State, and persistent Iranian and Russian efforts to exploit the power vacuum, together generate overlapping security, legal, and geopolitical risks. It critiques both U.S. disengagement and overextension, proposing instead a conditional engagement framework that links limited dialogue with HTS to verifiable counterterrorism cooperation, human‑rights reforms, and phased sanctions relief tied to measurable governance improvements. The paper further recommends strengthening local and regional partnerships, especially with actors such as the Syrian Democratic Forces, while using multilateral institutions and NGO‑led channels to deliver humanitarian aid without empowering armed groups. Overall, it concludes that sustained American leadership—rooted in patience, pragmatism, and multilateral burden‑sharing—offers the most realistic path to containing jihadist threats, constraining Iranian‑Russian influence, and supporting the emergence of a sovereign Syria aligned with regional stability and international norms.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张美国应采取"战略克制与有条件积极接触"相结合的策略应对叙利亚后阿萨德时代的复杂局面，通过有限对话、条件性合作和多边协调来稳定局势、遏制极端组织并管理大国竞争。
AI.research_question: 在后阿萨德时代的叙利亚，美国如何制定有效的战略来稳定局势、遏制极端组织、管理大国竞争，同时避免过度干预或完全撤出？
AI.motivation: 阿萨德政权垮台后，叙利亚出现权力真空，面临多重安全威胁：HTS成为主导力量、伊斯兰国卷土重来、伊朗和俄罗斯试图扩大影响力。美国既不能完全撤出（会导致局势恶化），也不能过度干预（会陷入泥潭），需要找到平衡点。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 战略克制理论：避免过度军事干预和政权更迭
2. 有条件接触框架：将合作与具体条件挂钩
3. 多边主义与负担分担：通过国际合作降低单边成本
4. 现实主义与务实外交：基于实际利益而非意识形态
AI.method: 政策分析研究方法，基于对叙利亚当前局势的评估，分析不同政策选项的利弊，提出综合性战略框架。采用案例分析和比较政策分析。
AI.findings:
1. 单纯撤出或过度干预都会失败
2. 有条件接触HTS可能促进反恐合作和人权改革
3. 加强地方伙伴关系（如叙利亚民主力量）至关重要
4. 多边人道援助渠道可避免武装团体获利
5. 耐心、务实的领导力最有可能实现稳定
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 发展了"战略克制与有条件接触"的混合战略框架
2. 提出了在复杂冲突环境中管理大国竞争的新思路
3. 丰富了后冲突国家治理的理论，强调渐进式改革和条件性合作
4. 为如何在非国家行为体主导的地区实施有效外交政策提供理论见解
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为美国制定叙利亚政策提供具体操作指南
2. 提出与HTS对话的条件框架（反恐合作、人权改革、治理改善）
3. 建议加强地方和区域伙伴关系网络
4. 设计多边人道援助机制以避免强化武装团体
5. 提供管理伊朗和俄罗斯影响力的实用策略

title: The Human Erasure Index (HEI): Thermodynamic Limits of Labor in High-Friction Economies

detail.title: The Human Erasure Index (HEI): Thermodynamic Limits of Labor in High-Friction Economies
detail.abstract: Traditional macroeconomic models often treat labor supply as elastic and human resilience as infinite. This paper proposes a dissenting framework: the Human Erasure Index (HEI). By applying the Joule-Lenz Law of thermodynamics (Q = I 2 • R • t) to socioeconomic systems, we argue that modern economies have reached a point of "Thermodynamic Decoupling." When systemic resistance (debt, inflation) exceeds a critical threshold, increased labor intensity no longer generates capital but instead generates social entropy-manifesting as fertility collapse, withdrawal (NEET), and rising mortality. Validated through longitudinal analysis of Japan (1990-2024) and cross-sectional PCA of OECD nations (2026), the model identifies a specific "Burnout Zone" where biological reproduction becomes economically inefficient.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"人类抹除指数"框架，将热力学焦耳-楞次定律应用于社会经济系统，认为现代经济已达到"热力学解耦"点：当系统阻力超过临界阈值时，增加劳动强度不再产生资本，而是产生社会熵，表现为生育率崩溃、NEET现象和死亡率上升。
AI.research_question: 当社会经济系统的阻力（债务、通胀）超过临界阈值时，增加劳动强度是否不再产生资本，而是产生社会熵（表现为生育率下降、NEET现象和死亡率上升）？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济模型将劳动力供给视为弹性且人类韧性无限，这无法解释生育率崩溃、NEET现象和死亡率上升等现代社会经济现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人类抹除指数框架，将热力学焦耳-楞次定律（Q = I²·R·t）应用于社会经济系统，提出"热力学解耦"概念和"倦怠区"理论。
AI.method: 日本（1990-2024）的纵向分析和OECD国家（2026）的横截面主成分分析。
AI.findings: 识别出特定的"倦怠区"，在此区域内生物繁殖变得经济无效率；当系统阻力超过临界阈值时，增加劳动强度确实产生社会熵而非资本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将热力学原理应用于社会经济分析的新框架，挑战传统宏观经济假设，为理解生育率下降和社会熵现象提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供识别社会经济"倦怠区"的工具，帮助设计避免热力学解耦的政策干预措施。

title: Paying the Price for Heat: Dynamic Effects of Abnormal Temperatures on China's Housing Market
affiliations: Wuhan Polytechnic University, Wuhan Polytechnic University, Wuhan University, Wuhan University and Wuhan University

detail.title: Paying the Price for Heat: Dynamic Effects of Abnormal Temperatures on China's Housing Market
detail.abstract: Climate-related risks are increasingly capitalized into housing values, fundamentally altering housing market dynamics and household decision-making. Using monthly panel data for 70 major Chinese cities over the period 2006–2020, this study adopts a multi-dimensional fixed-effects model to investigate the dynamic impacts of abnormal temperatures (standardized temperatures) on housing price changes. The empirical results show that abnormal temperatures exert significant negative lagged effects on price changes in both the new and second-hand housing markets. In terms of cumulative effects, a one-standard-deviation increase in temperature anomalies is associated with 0.123% and 0.135% declines in new and second-hand housing prices, respectively. This discounting effect is amplified by economic downturns, weakened consumer confidence, and heightened policy uncertainty. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the temperature effects on housing prices vary across city tiers, geographical regions, and housing floor areas. Further analysis indicates that rising abnormal temperatures not only generate immediate negative impacts on real estate investment but may also drive a structural shift toward improved housing. Finally, these findings carry meaningful implications for policymakers, households, and real estate investors.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2006-2020年中国70个主要城市的月度面板数据，通过多维固定效应模型分析异常温度对房价变化的动态影响。研究发现异常温度对新房和二手房价格均有显著的负向滞后效应，且这种折扣效应在经济衰退、消费者信心减弱和政策不确定性增加时会被放大。
AI.research_question: 异常温度如何动态影响中国主要城市的房价变化？这种影响在不同市场（新房vs二手房）、城市层级、地理区域和住房面积上是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 气候相关风险日益资本化到住房价值中，从根本上改变了住房市场动态和家庭决策。随着气候变化加剧，了解温度异常对房价的影响对于政策制定者、家庭和房地产投资者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候风险资本化理论、住房市场动态理论、家庭决策理论、环境经济学中的风险感知与资产定价理论。
AI.method: 使用2006-2020年中国70个主要城市的月度面板数据，采用多维固定效应模型分析标准化温度（异常温度）对房价变化的动态影响。通过累积效应分析、异质性分析和进一步的结构变化分析来深入探讨温度效应。
AI.findings: 1. 异常温度对新房和二手房价格均有显著的负向滞后效应；2. 温度异常增加一个标准差分别导致新房和二手房价格下降0.123%和0.135%；3. 折扣效应在经济衰退、消费者信心减弱和政策不确定性增加时被放大；4. 温度效应在不同城市层级、地理区域和住房面积上存在异质性；5. 异常温度上升不仅对房地产投资产生即时负面影响，还可能推动住房结构向改善型住房转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了气候风险资本化理论，提供了异常温度影响房价的实证证据；2. 揭示了温度效应的动态性和滞后性特征；3. 丰富了住房市场异质性分析的理论框架；4. 为理解气候风险如何通过经济条件和政策环境调节提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了气候风险管理的实证依据；2. 帮助家庭在购房决策中考虑气候风险因素；3. 为房地产投资者提供了风险定价的参考；4. 为城市规划和住房政策制定提供了气候适应性的决策支持；5. 有助于金融机构评估房地产贷款的气候风险。

title: Budget Constraint Assumption in Consumption Theory and Key Differences Between Hall's Random-Walk Hypothesis and Keynes-Clower-Wu's Income Growth Theory with Emphasis on Trade and the U.S. Presidential Election with Google Gemini Summary

detail.title: Budget Constraint Assumption in Consumption Theory and Key Differences Between Hall's Random-Walk Hypothesis and Keynes-Clower-Wu's Income Growth Theory with Emphasis on Trade and the U.S. Presidential Election with Google Gemini Summary
detail.abstract: In consumption theory, the assumption whether budget constraint is satisfied or not leads respectively to Hall's (1978) Random Walk Hypothesis and Keynes-Clower-Wu's Growth of Income Theory. Under these assumptions and applying Euler equation, Wu (2016) has shown that it is possible to show that consumption at period t+1 can be written with the summation Σ indices varying either from 0 to infinite (Hall) or from 1 to infinite (Wu), with both equations stating exactly the same result when written explicitly in the long form. Then, how is possible Hall's consumption result being independent of income and, in Wu's, change in savings being a function of income growth? To help explain this opposite view on income and the resulting conclusions one needs to understand the key differences in each approach, I employ Google Gemini with the objective of improving the understanding of consumption theory and with my two previously published examples, each with 50 plus years of data. Note that currently Gemini is limited by its capacity to manipulate most statistical database and/or to provide any basic mathematical calculations, such as yearly changes, or apply more advanced techniques, such as Euler equation.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨消费理论中预算约束假设如何导致Hall的随机游走假说与Keynes-Cloor-Wu的收入增长理论的对立观点，并通过Google Gemini工具分析这两种理论在解释消费与收入关系时的差异。
AI.research_question: 为什么在相同的欧拉方程框架下，Hall的消费结果独立于收入，而Wu的储蓄变化却是收入增长的函数？这两种对立观点背后的关键差异是什么？
AI.motivation: 消费理论中存在关于预算约束假设的根本分歧：Hall假设预算约束满足，得出消费随机游走假说（消费独立于收入）；而Keynes-Clower-Wu假设预算约束不满足，得出收入增长理论。这两种对立理论在解释消费行为时产生矛盾结论，需要深入理解其差异。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. Hall的随机游走假说（预算约束满足假设）
2. Keynes-Clower-Wu的收入增长理论（预算约束不满足假设）
3. 欧拉方程在消费理论中的应用
4. 消费函数的时间序列表示（从0到无穷求和 vs 从1到无穷求和）
AI.method:
1. 理论对比分析：比较Hall和Wu两种理论框架下的数学推导和假设差异
2. 使用Google Gemini作为分析工具，辅助理解消费理论
3. 基于作者先前发表的两个实证案例（各包含50多年数据）进行分析
4. 指出Gemini在统计数据处理和数学计算方面的局限性
AI.findings:
1. Hall和Wu的消费方程在显式长形式下表达相同的结果，但求和索引范围不同（0到无穷 vs 1到无穷）
2. 关键差异在于预算约束假设：Hall假设约束满足，Wu假设约束不满足
3. 这种假设差异导致对收入作用的相反解释：Hall认为消费独立于收入，Wu认为储蓄变化是收入增长的函数
4. Google Gemini作为分析工具存在局限性，无法处理统计数据库或进行基本数学计算
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 澄清了消费理论中预算约束假设的核心作用
2. 解释了为什么相同数学框架下会产生对收入作用的对立观点
3. 揭示了Hall和Wu理论在求和索引范围上的微妙但关键差异
4. 为理解消费与收入关系的理论分歧提供了分析框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者理解消费行为提供更全面的理论视角
2. 帮助实证研究者注意理论假设对分析结果的影响
3. 展示了AI工具（如Gemini）在理论分析中的潜在应用和局限性
4. 基于长期数据的案例分析为理论验证提供了实证参考

title: The Singular Function of Money: Medium of Exchange as the Constitutive Principle, with Implications for the Monetary Status of Bitcoin
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Singular Function of Money: Medium of Exchange as the Constitutive Principle, with Implications for the Monetary Status of Bitcoin
detail.abstract: This paper argues that money possesses exactly one constitutive function-that of a medium of exchange-and that the two remaining functions of the standard textbook triad (unit of account and store of value) are, respectively, a logical prerequisite and a temporal consequence of that singular function. The paper's principal contribution is the identification of a strict hierarchical structure-precondition → constitutive function → accidental property-that replaces the conventional coordinate triad with a precise logical architecture. Building on the Austrian tradition from Menger through Mises, Rothbard, and Selgin, who established that the medium of exchange is primary but did not explicate the exact relationships among the three supposed functions, the paper demonstrates that the unit of account is not an independent function but a necessary condition of possibility for exchange itself: without a standard of commensurability, no act of indirect exchange can occur.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为货币只有一个构成性功能——交换媒介，而标准教科书三元组中的另外两个功能（记账单位和价值储藏）分别是该单一功能的逻辑前提和时间结果。
AI.research_question: 货币的三个传统功能（交换媒介、记账单位、价值储藏）之间是否存在严格的逻辑层次结构？记账单位和价值储藏是否真的是独立的功能，还是交换媒介功能的逻辑前提和自然结果？
AI.motivation: 标准教科书将货币功能描述为三个并列的坐标功能，但奥地利学派传统（从门格尔到米塞斯、罗斯巴德、塞尔金）虽然确立了交换媒介的首要地位，却未能明确阐述这三个所谓功能之间的确切关系。需要建立一个更精确的逻辑架构来取代传统的三元组。
AI.theoretical_framework: 奥地利经济学传统（门格尔、米塞斯、罗斯巴德、塞尔金），货币理论，功能分析方法，逻辑层次结构理论。
AI.method: 理论分析、逻辑推理、概念分析，基于奥地利经济学传统进行理论构建和论证。
AI.findings: 货币只有一个构成性功能——交换媒介。记账单位不是独立功能，而是交换本身的必要条件（逻辑前提），没有可通约性的标准，间接交换行为就不可能发生。价值储藏是交换媒介功能的时间结果（偶然属性）。三者形成严格的层次结构：前提条件→构成性功能→偶然属性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了货币功能的严格层次结构，用精确的逻辑架构取代了传统的并列三元组；2. 明确了记账单位是交换媒介的逻辑前提而非独立功能；3. 确立了价值储藏是交换媒介功能的时间结果；4. 完善了奥地利学派关于货币功能的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为货币理论和教学提供了更清晰的概念框架；2. 有助于理解货币本质和货币政策的理论基础；3. 为分析货币现象提供了更精确的分析工具；4. 有助于澄清关于货币功能的常见误解。

title: Crisis Shock, ESG Investment and Stock Performance
affiliations: Guangzhou College of Commerce and Hunan University - School of Finance and Statistics

detail.title: Crisis Shock, ESG Investment and Stock Performance
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the role of Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) investment in mitigating the shock of crises on stock performance. We develop an asset pricing model in which investors’ decisions incorporate both ESG factors and exogenous crisis shocks. Our theoretical model indicates that ESG investment mitigates the negative effect of crises on stock performance, particularly for highly affected stocks. We empirically test this prediction using the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment, analyzing Chinese A-share listed firms from October 2019 to May 2020. The results show that a higher ESG level significantly improves the excess returns of stocks highly impacted by the crisis but has no statistically significant effect on those with low impact. These findings are consistent with our theoretical predictions. We find that ESG investing mitigates negative shocks by adjusting stocks’ market betas—an important channel for its impact on asset returns. This research contributes to understanding the differential impact of ESG investment on stock performance during crises and underscores financial capital’s role in promoting corporate green transformation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨ESG投资在缓解危机对股票表现的冲击中的作用。理论模型表明ESG投资能减轻危机对股票的负面影响，尤其对受危机影响大的股票。实证以COVID-19为自然实验，发现高ESG水平显著改善受危机高度影响股票的异常收益，但对低影响股票无显著效果。作用机制是通过调整股票的市场贝塔值。
AI.research_question: ESG投资如何缓解危机对股票表现的冲击？这种缓解作用是否存在异质性（对受危机影响程度不同的股票）？作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG投资日益重要，需要理解其在危机时期的作用。现有研究对ESG投资在危机中的保护作用机制和异质性影响了解不足，特别是缺乏理论模型支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建资产定价模型，将投资者决策中的ESG因素和外生危机冲击纳入考虑。理论预测ESG投资能缓解危机对股票表现的负面影响，尤其对受危机影响大的股票。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：开发包含ESG因素和危机冲击的资产定价模型；2. 实证检验：以COVID-19为自然实验，使用中国A股上市公司数据（2019年10月-2020年5月），分析ESG水平对股票异常收益的影响，区分高/低危机影响股票。
AI.findings: 1. 高ESG水平显著改善受危机高度影响股票的异常收益；2. 对受危机低影响股票的异常收益无显著影响；3. 作用机制：ESG投资通过调整股票的市场贝塔值来缓解负面冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了包含ESG因素和危机冲击的资产定价理论模型；2. 揭示了ESG投资在危机中的异质性保护作用；3. 阐明了ESG通过调整市场贝塔值影响资产回报的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者在危机时期配置ESG资产提供决策依据；2. 为企业进行绿色转型提供金融激励；3. 为政策制定者理解金融资本在促进企业绿色转型中的作用提供参考。

title: Conceptual models in behavioral finance: Literacy, inclusion, and financial behavior from a systematic review and analysis of the knowledge structure
affiliations: Universidad Autónoma de Manizales, Universidad Autónoma de Manizales, Universidad Autónoma de Manizales and Universidad Autónoma de Manizales

detail.title: Conceptual models in behavioral finance: Literacy, inclusion, and financial behavior from a systematic review and analysis of the knowledge structure
detail.abstract: We review 2000–2024 evidence on financial literacy, inclusion, and behavior using PRISMA-NMA screening (514 Scopus/WoS records), bibliometric networks (citations, co-authorship, co-citation, co-occurrence), and a Tree of Science structure. Post-2014 output accelerates, with U.S. impact leadership and rising Asian contributions. The field clusters into literacy–well-being, inclusion under structural/digital constraints, and education/socialization mechanisms, supporting capability-based models and exposing gaps in longitudinal and equity-focused research.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述和文献计量分析，梳理了2000-2024年间金融素养、金融包容和金融行为领域的研究进展，识别了主要研究集群和发展趋势。
AI.research_question: 金融素养、金融包容和金融行为研究领域在2000-2024年间的发展轨迹、知识结构和研究空白是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着金融素养和金融包容性成为全球政策议程的核心，需要系统梳理该领域的研究进展，识别知识结构和研究空白，为未来研究提供方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力基础模型（capability-based models）、金融社会化理论、结构约束理论、数字金融理论
AI.method: 采用PRISMA-NMA筛选方法（514篇Scopus/WoS文献），结合文献计量网络分析（引文网络、合著网络、共被引网络、共现网络）和科学树结构分析
AI.findings: 1. 2014年后研究产出加速增长；2. 美国在影响力方面领先，亚洲贡献显著上升；3. 研究领域分为三个主要集群：金融素养与福祉、结构/数字约束下的金融包容、教育/社会化机制；4. 支持能力基础模型；5. 暴露了纵向研究和公平导向研究的空白
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了能力基础模型在解释金融行为中的适用性；2. 揭示了金融素养、包容和行为研究的多维知识结构；3. 识别了理论发展的关键空白领域
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了研究证据的综合概览；2. 指出了需要加强纵向跟踪和公平性研究的实践领域；3. 为教育干预和金融包容项目设计提供了理论依据

title: The Great Capital Migration: Fiscal Dominance, JPY Carry Unwinds, and the Structural Pivot to Alternative Assets
affiliations: and Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati

detail.title: The Great Capital Migration: Fiscal Dominance, JPY Carry Unwinds, and the Structural Pivot to Alternative Assets
detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural realignment of the global financial landscape in 2026, driven by the convergence of "sticky" US inflation, record fiscal deficits, and the exhaustion of traditional monetary toolkits. We analyze the implications of the Japanese Yen (JPY) carry trade unwind, which will remove a critical liquidity backstop for US Treasuries, forcing a repricing of the global "risk-free" rate. Our findings suggest that the traditional bond-centric portfolio will undergo a fundamental transformation. As US debt sustainability concerns and geopolitical trade fragmentations intensify, capital is increasingly migrating toward alternative stores of value— Gold, Silver and into private markets. We highlight a burgeoning "infrastructure cycle," led by an estimated $602 billion investment in AI data centers for 2026 alone. The paper concludes a strong possibility of structural debasement leading to flow of money towards alternative store of values.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了2026年全球金融格局的结构性调整，主要驱动因素包括美国"粘性"通胀、创纪录财政赤字和传统货币政策工具失效。研究发现日元套利交易平仓将移除美债关键流动性支持，迫使全球"无风险"利率重新定价，传统债券投资组合将发生根本性转变。资本正流向黄金、白银和私募市场等替代价值储存工具，同时AI数据中心投资将引领基础设施周期。
AI.research_question: 2026年全球金融格局的结构性调整将如何重塑传统投资组合和资本流动模式？
AI.motivation: 美国"粘性"通胀、创纪录财政赤字和传统货币政策工具失效的汇聚效应，加上日元套利交易平仓将移除美债关键流动性支持，这些因素共同推动全球金融格局的结构性调整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球金融结构理论、套利交易理论、无风险利率定价理论、债务可持续性理论、价值储存理论
AI.method: 基于宏观经济数据和金融市场的分析性研究，结合定量预测（如2026年AI数据中心6020亿美元投资预测）和定性分析
AI.findings: 1) 日元套利交易平仓将迫使全球"无风险"利率重新定价；2) 传统债券投资组合将发生根本性转变；3) 资本正流向黄金、白银和私募市场等替代价值储存工具；4) AI数据中心投资将引领基础设施周期；5) 结构性贬值可能导致资金流向替代价值储存工具
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了全球金融格局结构性调整的新框架；2) 深化了套利交易与全球流动性关系的理解；3) 拓展了无风险利率重新定价的理论机制；4) 发展了替代价值储存工具在金融转型中的作用理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为投资者提供传统债券投资组合转型的指导；2) 识别AI数据中心等基础设施投资机会；3) 预警全球金融风险并建议资产配置策略；4) 为政策制定者提供债务可持续性和货币政策调整的参考

title: Adaptive Hybrid Time-Series Modelling with Residual Learning for Solar Irradiation Forecasting across Diverse Climatic Regions in India
affiliations: National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli and National Institute of Technology Tiruchirappalli

detail.title: Adaptive Hybrid Time-Series Modelling with Residual Learning for Solar Irradiation Forecasting across Diverse Climatic Regions in India
detail.abstract: Solar Irradiation prediction has been an essential study in recent times, owing to the increasing penetration of renewable energy in the Indian grid. This study presents an adaptive hybrid modelling framework for hourly solar irradiation prediction. The model is developed to maintain reliable results in a variety of climatic conditions. The method followed in this study combines a machine learning-based residual correction mechanism using Light Gradient Boosting Machine with existing statistical time-series models. While residual learning captures structured nonlinear errors that are not captured by time-series methods, adaptive hybridisation is used to dynamically combine baseline model forecasts based on temporal performance. Multi-year hourly solar irradiation data from six geographically different locations in India representing arid, coastal, inland, and mountainous climates, are used to assess the framework. When compared to standalone base models, the results show a mean Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 41.52 Wh/m², a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 27.68 Wh/m², and a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 16.42% across all locations. This justification capability is further strengthened by strong values of coefficients of determination, varying between 0.976 and 0.993. Along with evaluation of error values at points, other techniques, namely the residual Probability Density Function (PDF), indicate decay of extreme values (90th percentile) of errors to 50-78 Wh/m², whereas scaling analysis based on power Spectral Density (PSD) indicates spectral exponents (β = 1.81∼2.01) to be very close to that of the observed signal (β = 1.79∼2.48), indicating maintenance of native temporal variability at different locations.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种自适应混合建模框架用于小时级太阳辐照度预测，结合机器学习残差校正和统计时间序列模型，在印度六种不同气候条件下验证了其有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个自适应混合建模框架，在多种气候条件下实现可靠的小时级太阳辐照度预测？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源在印度电网中的渗透率不断增加，太阳辐照度预测变得至关重要，需要开发能够在不同气候条件下保持可靠性的预测模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合建模框架：结合统计时间序列模型和机器学习残差校正机制（LightGBM），采用自适应混合策略动态组合基线模型预测。
AI.method: 使用印度六个地理不同地点（代表干旱、沿海、内陆和山区气候）的多年度小时级太阳辐照度数据，结合LightGBM残差校正和自适应混合方法，评估框架性能。
AI.findings: 模型在所有地点平均RMSE为41.52 Wh/m²，MAE为27.68 Wh/m²，MAPE为16.42%，决定系数在0.976-0.993之间。残差PDF显示极端误差值（90百分位）降至50-78 Wh/m²，功率谱密度分析显示谱指数（β=1.81∼2.01）接近观测信号（β=1.79∼2.48）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了自适应混合建模框架，将机器学习残差校正与传统时间序列模型相结合，理论上改进了太阳辐照度预测的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度电网提供了可在多种气候条件下应用的太阳辐照度预测工具，有助于提高可再生能源并网的可靠性和电网稳定性。

title: Emergence of Cashless Payments and Its Psychological Implications

detail.title: Emergence of Cashless Payments and Its Psychological Implications
detail.abstract: The aim of this study is to use qualitative secondary research by analysing peer-reviewed journals, surveys, statistical databases and secondary behavioural reports to assess and identify developments and adoption of cashless payment methods in societies. It also includes the benefits, negative aspects, delving into the BNPL schemes, and psychological drivers revolving around such a banking system. A delve into the UAE is additionally studied, being an ideal example of a stable developed technological-driven economy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过定性二次研究分析同行评审期刊、调查、统计数据库和二次行为报告，评估和识别社会中无现金支付方法的发展和采用情况，包括其益处、负面影响、BNPL计划以及围绕此类银行系统的心理驱动因素，并以阿联酋作为稳定发达技术驱动型经济的理想案例进行研究。
AI.research_question: 无现金支付方法在社会中的发展和采用情况如何？其益处、负面影响、BNPL计划以及围绕此类银行系统的心理驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着数字技术的发展，无现金支付方式在全球范围内迅速普及，了解其发展轨迹、采用情况、影响和潜在问题对于政策制定、商业策略和消费者保护具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳理论、行为经济学、消费者心理学、金融创新理论、数字支付生态系统理论
AI.method: 定性二次研究方法，分析同行评审期刊、调查数据、统计数据库和二次行为报告
AI.findings: 研究发现无现金支付在全球范围内加速发展，带来便利性和效率提升，但也存在隐私安全、金融排斥等负面影响；BNPL计划改变了消费模式，心理驱动因素包括即时满足、社会比较和认知偏差；阿联酋作为技术驱动型经济体展示了无现金支付的成功应用模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术采纳理论在无现金支付领域的应用，深化了对数字支付心理驱动因素的理解，为金融创新理论提供了实证支持，构建了无现金支付生态系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供无现金支付监管建议，为金融机构设计更安全的支付产品，为消费者提供风险防范指导，为企业制定数字支付战略，为阿联酋等经济体提供可借鉴的发展模式。

title: Sustainable recovery of Mg²⁺ from low-grade magnesite via FeCl₃ leaching for the controllable synthesis of hydrated magnesium carbonates
affiliations: Shenyang Ligong University, Shenyang Ligong University, Northeastern University, Shenyang Ligong University, Shenyang Ligong University, Shenyang Ligong University, Shenyang Ligong University and Shenyang Ligong University

detail.title: Sustainable recovery of Mg²⁺ from low-grade magnesite via FeCl₃ leaching for the controllable synthesis of hydrated magnesium carbonates
detail.abstract: With the extensive mining practice of "selecting rich deposits while discarding poor ones" in magnesite extraction, low-grade magnesite have gradually become the mainstream raw material. To significantly enhance their comprehensive utilization value, this study employs a leaching method, utilizing low-grade magnesite as a magnesium source and FeCl₃ solution as a leaching agent to extract Mg²⁺ from the ores in a single step. The resulting magnesium salt solution was then reacted with Na₂CO₃ to produce hydrated magnesium carbonate. Orthogonal experiments and XRD, SEM, TEM, and XPS analyses systematically investigated the effects of reaction temperature, reaction time, and leaching agent concentration on Mg²⁺ leaching rate, and the phase composition and microstructure of leaching residues. Results indicate that at 120°C and a FeCl3 concentration of 0.1 mol/L, the Mg²⁺ leaching rate reached 91.18%. After treatment with ferric chloride, the magnesite surface roughened, facilitating Mg²⁺leaching into the solution. The leaching residue was Fe₂O₃. Subsequently, reacting with an appropriate amount of Na₂CO₃ solution at 50°C and 80°C for 2 h yielded nesquehonite and hydromagnesite. This study provides a new strategy for the high-value, environmentally friendly utilization of low-grade magnesite resources.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用FeCl₃浸出法从低品位菱镁矿中提取镁离子，通过正交实验优化条件，在120°C、0.1 mol/L FeCl₃浓度下获得91.18%的镁浸出率，浸出残渣为Fe₂O₃。镁盐溶液与Na₂CO₃反应生成水合碳酸镁（nesquehonite和hydromagnesite），为低品位菱镁矿的高值化环保利用提供新策略。
AI.research_question: 如何通过FeCl₃浸出法高效提取低品位菱镁矿中的镁离子，并将其转化为高附加值的水合碳酸镁产品？
AI.motivation: 随着菱镁矿开采中"采富弃贫"的广泛实践，低品位菱镁矿已成为主流原料。为提高其综合利用价值，需要开发高效环保的提取和转化技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于浸出化学原理，利用FeCl₃溶液作为浸出剂，通过离子交换反应提取镁离子；后续通过沉淀反应生成水合碳酸镁。
AI.method: 采用正交实验设计，系统研究反应温度、反应时间、浸出剂浓度对镁浸出率的影响；使用XRD、SEM、TEM、XPS分析浸出残渣的相组成和微观结构。
AI.findings: 在120°C、FeCl₃浓度0.1 mol/L条件下，镁浸出率达到91.18%；FeCl₃处理使菱镁矿表面粗糙化，促进镁离子浸出；浸出残渣为Fe₂O₃；镁盐溶液与Na₂CO₃在50°C和80°C反应2小时可分别生成nesquehonite和hydromagnesite。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了FeCl₃浸出低品位菱镁矿的工艺理论体系，揭示了浸出过程中相变和微观结构演化机制，为类似矿物资源的浸出提取提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种高效、环保的低品位菱镁矿高值化利用新工艺，可将低品位资源转化为高附加值的水合碳酸镁产品，同时实现资源综合利用和环境保护。

title: Dual-Domain Collaborative Pump Noise Suppression Network for Measurement While Drilling Communications
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, China Oilfield Services Ltd and China Oilfield Services Ltd

detail.title: Dual-Domain Collaborative Pump Noise Suppression Network for Measurement While Drilling Communications
detail.abstract: Mud pulse telemetry signals in Measurement While Drilling (MWD) systems suffer from severe, non-stationary pump noise that traditional single-domain filtering struggles to separate. To address this, we propose a dual-domain collaborative pump noise suppression network (DPNSNet). The network first utilizes a Spectral Signature Encoder to extract multi-scale frequency-domain features and generate a prior mask. Subsequently, guided by this mask, a Temporal Dynamics Estimator, which integrates a Local Global Context Block and Spectral Correlation Layers, simultaneously captures short- and long-term temporal dependencies alongside cross-band harmonic coupling to progressively approximate the true noise distribution. Finally, a Mask-Guided Gated Fusion module adaptively integrates the multi-stage recursive estimations. Extensive evaluations on simulated and field drilling data demonstrate that DPNSNet effectively mitigates pump interference under low SNR and diverse conditions, maximizing in-band signal gain and significantly reducing the system BER.

AI.tldr: 提出DPNSNet网络，通过双域协作抑制MWD系统中的泥浆脉冲遥测信号泵噪声，在低信噪比和多样化条件下有效提升信号质量
AI.research_question: 如何有效抑制测量随钻系统中泥浆脉冲遥测信号的非平稳泵噪声？
AI.motivation: 传统单域滤波方法难以分离MWD系统中严重的非平稳泵噪声，影响信号质量和系统性能
AI.theoretical_framework: 双域协作噪声抑制理论，结合频域特征提取和时域动态估计，利用先验掩码引导的融合机制
AI.method: DPNSNet网络：1) 频谱特征编码器提取多尺度频域特征并生成先验掩码；2) 时域动态估计器（含局部全局上下文块和频谱相关层）捕获短长期时域依赖和跨频带谐波耦合；3) 掩码引导门控融合模块自适应集成多阶段递归估计
AI.findings: 在模拟和现场钻井数据上的广泛评估表明，DPNSNet在低信噪比和多样化条件下有效抑制泵干扰，最大化带内信号增益，显著降低系统误码率
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双域协作的泵噪声抑制网络框架，整合频域特征提取和时域动态估计，创新性地使用先验掩码引导的融合机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为MWD系统提供有效的泵噪声抑制解决方案，提高泥浆脉冲遥测信号质量，降低系统误码率，提升钻井作业效率和安全性

title: More Hype than Hope. Hydrogen Policy, Projects, and Environmental Conflicts
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: More Hype than Hope. Hydrogen Policy, Projects, and Environmental Conflicts
detail.abstract: Hydrogen plays a central role in policies aimed at decarbonisation, energy autonomy, industrial competitiveness, and development. This study analyses hydrogen policies, revealing how their design may undermine just transition goals and instead reinforce existing spatial inequalities. Drawing on the International Energy Agency (IEA) data on clean hydrogen rojects, investment trends are examined. A spatial analysis combining project data with environmental conflicts, sourced from the Atlas of Environmental Justice, reveals a concentration of hydrogen projects in areas affected by ecological degradation and socio-environmental disparities, raising concerns about the socio-ecological distributive effects. Hydrogen development appears largely driven by market logic and seems unlikely to meet climate targets.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析氢能政策，揭示其设计可能破坏公正转型目标并加剧现有空间不平等。基于IEA清洁氢项目数据，研究发现氢项目集中在生态退化和社会环境差异地区，主要由市场逻辑驱动，难以实现气候目标。
AI.research_question: 氢能政策设计如何影响公正转型目标？氢能项目在空间分布上是否加剧了现有的社会环境和空间不平等？
AI.motivation: 氢能在脱碳、能源自主、工业竞争力和发展中扮演核心角色，但现有政策设计可能忽视公正转型目标，需要研究氢能政策对空间不平等的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公正转型理论、空间不平等理论、环境正义理论、市场逻辑与气候目标冲突理论
AI.method: 基于国际能源署(IEA)清洁氢项目数据，结合环境正义地图集的环境冲突数据，进行空间分析，考察投资趋势和项目分布。
AI.findings: 1. 氢项目集中在生态退化和社会环境差异地区；2. 氢能发展主要由市场逻辑驱动；3. 当前氢能发展模式难以实现气候目标；4. 氢能政策可能加剧现有空间不平等。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将公正转型理论应用于氢能政策分析；2. 揭示氢能发展与空间不平等的关系；3. 提出市场逻辑与气候目标的冲突框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供氢能政策设计的公正性考量；2. 指出氢能项目选址需要避免加剧环境不公；3. 建议调整氢能发展模式以实现气候和公正转型双重目标。

title: Sustainable and inclusive wellbeing governance: reinventing democracy after the crisis
affiliations: University College London, University of Padua, The Club of Rome, University of Pretoria, University of Rome Tor Vergata, Australian National University (ANU), affiliation not provided to SSRN, University College London, The Club of Rome, Northumbria University, University of Iceland, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Nottingham

detail.title: Sustainable and inclusive wellbeing governance: reinventing democracy after the crisis
detail.abstract: Despite decades of advances in sustainability science, global progress on climate change, biodiversity loss, inequality, and human wellbeing remains dangerously inadequate. While these failures are often attributed to insufficient political will or contested knowledge, we argue that a more fundamental constraint lies in how collective decisions are made. Contemporary governance systems are increasingly shaped by concentrated economic and political power, undermining their capacity to act in the collective interest and to pursue long-term sustainability goals. At the same time, there is growing evidence that citizens broadly support transformative policies aimed at sustainable and inclusive wellbeing. We argue that governance design itself has become a critical leverage point for sustainability transitions. For example, deliberative democracy offers an alternative by representing shared societal values and goals through randomly selected citizens’ assemblies. Such assemblies operate independently of partisan and special-interest control and have demonstrated success at several scales. Advances in communication technology now make their broad application increasingly feasible. In parallel, new decision-making methods, such as sociocracy, emphasise consent over majority rule and provide tools to reduce polarisation and foster inclusive agreements. Viewed historically, today’s governance challenges resemble recurrent crises and may offer a critical opening to adopt more sustainable and inclusive forms of governance, grounded in deliberation, consent, and collective wellbeing.

AI.tldr: 本文认为当前可持续发展进展不足的根本原因在于治理决策方式，而非政治意愿或知识争议。文章提出治理设计本身是可持续发展的关键杠杆点，倡导通过审议民主（如公民大会）和共识决策方法（如社会民主）来改革治理体系。
AI.research_question: 治理设计如何成为可持续发展转型的关键杠杆点？特别是，审议民主和共识决策方法如何能够克服当前治理体系的局限性，促进可持续和包容性的集体福祉？
AI.motivation: 尽管可持续发展科学取得数十年进展，但在气候变化、生物多样性丧失、不平等和人类福祉等全球挑战上进展仍然严重不足。这些失败通常归因于政治意愿不足或知识争议，但作者认为更根本的制约在于集体决策方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 治理理论：强调治理设计作为可持续发展杠杆点的理论框架；2) 审议民主理论：随机选择公民大会作为替代治理模式；3) 共识决策理论：社会民主等强调同意而非多数统治的决策方法；4) 历史制度主义：将当前治理挑战视为历史性危机和制度变革机会。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性论文，基于现有文献和案例研究进行论证。通过分析当前治理体系的局限性（经济和政治权力集中），对比审议民主和共识决策方法的优势，提出治理改革的路径。
AI.findings: 1) 当前治理体系受经济政治权力集中影响，难以追求长期集体利益；2) 公民普遍支持可持续包容性政策；3) 审议民主（如公民大会）能代表社会共同价值观，独立于党派和特殊利益控制；4) 共识决策方法能减少两极分化，促进包容性协议；5) 技术进步使广泛实施成为可能；6) 当前危机为治理改革提供了历史性机遇。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将治理设计确立为可持续发展转型的关键理论杠杆点；2) 整合审议民主和共识决策理论，构建综合性治理改革框架；3) 提出历史性危机作为制度变革机会的理论视角；4) 挑战传统将可持续发展失败归因于政治意愿不足的主流解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供具体的治理改革方案（公民大会、社会民主等）；2) 展示审议民主在不同规模的成功案例；3) 利用现代通信技术扩大审议民主应用的可能性；4) 提供减少政治两极分化的实用决策工具；5) 在当前治理危机中提出可行的转型路径。

title: THE PRICE OF PERFORMANCE: A CAUSAL DECOMPOSITION OF SUSTAINABILITY VALUE IN COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: THE PRICE OF PERFORMANCE: A CAUSAL DECOMPOSITION OF SUSTAINABILITY VALUE IN COMMERCIAL REAL ESTATE
detail.abstract: This study challenges the static treatment of the "green premium" in commercial real estate. We introduce and empirically validate the Sustainability Value Decomposition Theory, a novel framework that disaggregates environmental premiums into three distinct effects: Signalling (the value of the label), Performance (the value of operational efficiency), and Market Access (the value of regulatory compliance). Using a mixed-methods approach that combines econometric analysis of 111 institutional office transactions in London and an instrumental variable (IV) strategy to ensure causal identification, we isolate these distinct drivers of value. Our 2SLS model reveals a robust causal premium of 9.5% for top-tier BREEAM certification, correcting for the upward bias found in standard models. Critically, mediation analysis demonstrates that superior energy performance is the primary value driver, causally mediating 73.8% of the observed certification premium. We also provide the first robust quantification of a "brown discount" in a major European market, documenting a 24.7% valuation penalty for assets non-compliant with minimum energy standards, clear evidence of the Market Access effect. These findings fundamentally reframe ESG investment strategy, demonstrating a decisive market shift from valuing symbolic labels to pricing tangible performance and regulatory risk.

AI.tldr: 本研究挑战了商业地产中"绿色溢价"的静态处理，提出了可持续性价值分解理论，将环境溢价分解为信号效应、绩效效应和市场准入效应。通过伦敦111宗机构办公交易的经济计量分析和工具变量策略，发现顶级BREEAM认证的因果溢价为9.5%，其中73.8%由能源绩效驱动，并首次量化了欧洲市场的"棕色折扣"为24.7%。
AI.research_question: 商业地产中的"绿色溢价"如何分解为不同的价值驱动因素？顶级绿色建筑认证的因果溢价是多少？能源绩效在绿色溢价中扮演什么角色？是否存在"棕色折扣"效应？
AI.motivation: 现有研究将绿色溢价视为静态概念，未能区分认证标签、实际绩效和监管合规性的不同价值贡献。需要更精细的理论框架来理解绿色建筑价值的本质驱动因素，为ESG投资提供更精准的策略指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续性价值分解理论：将环境溢价分解为三个效应：1) 信号效应（标签价值），2) 绩效效应（运营效率价值），3) 市场准入效应（监管合规价值）。
AI.method: 混合方法：对伦敦111宗机构办公交易进行经济计量分析，采用工具变量策略确保因果识别，使用2SLS模型估计因果溢价，通过中介分析检验能源绩效的中介作用。
AI.findings: 1) 顶级BREEAM认证的因果溢价为9.5%；2) 能源绩效中介了73.8%的认证溢价；3) 首次量化欧洲市场的"棕色折扣"为24.7%（不符合最低能源标准的资产）；4) 标准模型存在向上偏差。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了可持续性价值分解理论，为理解绿色建筑价值提供了更精细的理论框架；挑战了绿色溢价的静态概念；首次在欧洲市场量化了棕色折扣效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ESG投资策略提供新视角：市场从重视象征性标签转向定价实际绩效和监管风险；投资者应关注能源绩效而非仅认证标签；识别不符合能源标准资产的重大价值风险。

title: Money, Credit, and Banking in a Heterogeneous-Agent New-Monetarist Model
affiliations: Bank of Korea, Sungkyunkwan University - Department of Economics and Duke University

detail.title: Money, Credit, and Banking in a Heterogeneous-Agent New-Monetarist Model
detail.abstract: We revisit the liquidity-transformation mechanism of competitive banking in Berentsen, Camera and Waller (2007), a representative-agent economy, and study how its implications change in an empirically relevant heterogeneous-agent environment. Unlike the representative agent model, our model endogenously generates a positive mass of hand-to-mouth households with zero liquid assets, leading to a right-skewed distribution of liquidity. In this setting, bank credit substitutes for cash self-insurance and reduces equilibrium money demand despite the presence of deposit returns. Quantitatively, banking is still essential, but the source of these gains differs from Berentsen et al. (2007) and varies with inflation: welfare improvements are relatively more deposit-driven at low inflation, while they become increasingly borrower-drivenat higher inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了竞争性银行的流动性转换机制，在异质性代理人环境中研究其影响。与代表性代理人模型不同，该模型内生地产生了零流动资产的"手到口"家庭，导致流动性分布右偏。在此设定下，银行信贷替代了现金自我保险，降低了均衡货币需求。量化分析显示，银行业仍然重要，但福利改善的来源随通胀变化：低通胀时更多由存款驱动，高通胀时更多由借款驱动。
AI.research_question: 在异质性代理人环境中，竞争性银行的流动性转换机制如何影响经济？其福利效应与代表性代理人模型有何不同？
AI.motivation: Berentsen, Camera and Waller (2007)的代表性代理人模型未能捕捉现实经济中家庭流动性持有的异质性，特别是存在大量"手到口"家庭的现象。需要研究在更符合实证的异质性代理人环境中，银行业流动性转换机制的作用和福利影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Berentsen, Camera and Waller (2007)的竞争性银行流动性转换模型框架，但扩展到异质性代理人环境，引入内生流动性约束和右偏流动性分布。
AI.method: 构建异质性代理人动态一般均衡模型，内生化"手到口"家庭的形成，进行量化分析，比较不同通胀水平下的福利效应分解。
AI.findings: 1. 模型内生产生零流动资产的"手到口"家庭，形成右偏流动性分布；2. 银行信贷替代现金自我保险，降低均衡货币需求；3. 银行业仍然提供重要福利改善，但来源随通胀变化：低通胀时更多来自存款收益，高通胀时更多来自借款机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将银行流动性转换机制扩展到异质性代理人环境；2. 内生解释"手到口"家庭现象和右偏流动性分布；3. 揭示银行信贷与现金自我保险的替代关系；4. 提供通胀水平影响银行业福利效应来源的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解现实经济中银行业的作用提供更准确的框架；2. 帮助政策制定者评估不同通胀环境下银行政策的效果；3. 为金融包容性和家庭流动性管理政策提供理论依据。

title: SCT:Symmetric Collaborative Training for Precise Regulation of Bidirectional Time-Lagged Central Heating
affiliations: Shandong Technology and Business University, Shandong Technology and Business University, Shandong Technology and Business University, Shandong Technology and Business University, Shandong Technology and Business University and Shandong Technology and Business University

detail.title: SCT:Symmetric Collaborative Training for Precise Regulation of Bidirectional Time-Lagged Central Heating
