detail.abstract: Central heating systems constitute critical infrastructure for maintaining residential well-being during winter. Accurate and dynamic regulation of these systems is essential to balance occupant thermal comfort and building energy consumption. However, effective regulation is very challenging due to significant time delays caused by building thermal inertia, particularly the bidirectional temporal coupling between supply water setpoints and future indoor temperature states. Current control decisions depend on forecasts of future indoor temperatures, while those future states are in turn determined by the control decisions themselves. This cyclic dependency undermines the effectiveness of traditional unidirectional prediction models for closed-loop fine-tuning, especially in the absence of real-time feedback. To address this challenge, we propose a Symmetric Collaborative Training (SCT) framework which unifies two coupled prediction tasks into a single collaborative learning objective, optimizing dual-branch predictions via a consistency constraint mechanism. This framework is composed of two complementary sub-networks: TCCA-Former and DA-GRU. Specifically, TCCA-Former leverages a cross-attention fusion mechanism that combines Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) and Transformer encoders to synthesize local temporal features with global long-range dependencies. Simultaneously, DA-GRU incorporates dual feature and temporal attention mechanisms within its recurrent units, thereby improving representational capacity for multi-dimensional time series through adaptive isolation of salient features and critical temporal moments. Experimental results on real-world heating datasets demonstrate that the SCT framework significantly outperforms established baselines across both coupled tasks, exhibiting superior prediction accuracy and enhanced system robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种对称协作训练（SCT）框架，通过统一两个耦合预测任务来解决中央供暖系统中控制决策与未来室内温度状态之间的双向时间耦合问题，显著提升了预测精度和系统鲁棒性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效解决中央供暖系统中控制决策与未来室内温度状态之间的双向时间耦合问题，以实现更准确和动态的供暖系统调节？
AI.motivation: 中央供暖系统对冬季居民福祉至关重要，但建筑热惯性导致显著的时间延迟，形成了供水设定点与未来室内温度状态之间的双向时间耦合。这种循环依赖关系削弱了传统单向预测模型在闭环微调中的有效性，特别是在缺乏实时反馈的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 对称协作训练（SCT）框架，将两个耦合预测任务统一到单一协作学习目标中，通过一致性约束机制优化双分支预测。该框架包含两个互补子网络：TCCA-Former（结合TCN和Transformer编码器的交叉注意力融合机制）和DA-GRU（包含双重特征和时间注意力机制的循环单元）。
AI.method: 提出SCT框架，包含TCCA-Former和DA-GRU两个子网络。TCCA-Former利用交叉注意力融合机制结合TCN和Transformer编码器，综合局部时间特征与全局长期依赖关系。DA-GRU在其循环单元中融入双重特征和时间注意力机制，通过自适应隔离显著特征和关键时间点来提升多维时间序列的表征能力。
AI.findings: 在实际供暖数据集上的实验结果表明，SCT框架在两个耦合任务上均显著优于现有基线方法，展现出优越的预测精度和增强的系统鲁棒性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了对称协作训练框架，解决了双向时间耦合问题；2. 开发了TCCA-Former网络，有效融合局部和全局时间特征；3. 设计了DA-GRU网络，增强了多维时间序列的表征能力；4. 建立了统一协作学习目标的一致性约束机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为中央供暖系统提供了更准确和动态的调节方法；2. 提升了供暖系统的能源效率和居民热舒适度平衡；3. 增强了系统在缺乏实时反馈情况下的鲁棒性；4. 为类似具有时间延迟和耦合特性的控制系统提供了可借鉴的解决方案。

title: DiffFuseNet: Infrared-Visible Image Fusion via Diffusion-Guided Feature Alignment and Consistency Learning
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: DiffFuseNet: Infrared-Visible Image Fusion via Diffusion-Guided Feature Alignment and Consistency Learning

keywords.keywords: Image Fusion； Diffusion Model； Consistency Learning；Frequency Decomposition ；Explicit Decoupling

detail.abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to synthesize images with both thermal radiation and rich texture details. However, existing methods suffer from inadequate feature representation and imbalanced fusion due to cross-modal discrepancies, leading to blurred details or insufficient thermal target saliency. To address this, we propose DiffFuseNet, a fusion network with diffusion-guided feature enhancement and explicit feature decoupling. A Dual Diffusion-based Feature Enhancement (D²FE) module enhances cross-modal feature robustness via controllable noise injection and denoising regularization. An Explicit Decoupling and Frequency Decomposition (EDFD) module explicitly separates features into shared, modality-specific, and frequency-aware components. Coupled with a frequency-aware fusion mechanism using Haar wavelet and invertible neural networks and a two-stage training strategy, our approach achieves balanced information integration. Experiments on M3FD, RoadScene, and TNO datasets show DiffFuseNet outperforms state-of-the-art in visual quality and objective metrics, with superior detail preservation, thermal target saliency, and structural consistency.

AI.tldr: DiffFuseNet是一个用于红外与可见光图像融合的网络，通过扩散引导的特征增强和显式特征解耦来解决现有方法特征表示不足和融合不平衡的问题，在多个数据集上实现了更好的视觉质量和客观指标。
AI.research_question: 如何解决红外与可见光图像融合中因跨模态差异导致的特征表示不足和融合不平衡问题？
AI.motivation: 现有红外与可见光图像融合方法存在特征表示不足和融合不平衡的问题，导致细节模糊或热目标显著性不足，需要新的方法来平衡热辐射信息和纹理细节的融合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于扩散模型的特征增强理论，特征解耦理论，以及频率分解理论，结合Haar小波和可逆神经网络进行频率感知融合。
AI.method: 提出DiffFuseNet网络，包含双扩散特征增强模块（D²FE）和显式解耦频率分解模块（EDFD），采用两阶段训练策略，使用Haar小波和可逆神经网络进行频率感知融合。
AI.findings: 在M3FD、RoadScene和TNO数据集上的实验表明，DiffFuseNet在视觉质量和客观指标上优于现有方法，具有更好的细节保留、热目标显著性和结构一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了扩散引导的特征增强和显式特征解耦的理论框架，将扩散模型的噪声注入和去噪正则化应用于跨模态特征增强，发展了频率感知的图像融合理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了DiffFuseNet系统，为红外与可见光图像融合提供了有效的解决方案，可应用于监控、自动驾驶、军事侦察等领域，提升图像融合的质量和实用性。

title: Compact Feature Distributions and Refined Pseudo Labels for Weakly Supervised Incremental Semantic Segmentation
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: Compact Feature Distributions and Refined Pseudo Labels for Weakly Supervised Incremental Semantic Segmentation
detail.abstract: Weakly Supervised Incremental Learning for Semantic Segmentation (WILSS) aims to segment novel classes while avoiding catastrophic forgetting based on image-level labels. However, WILSS faces two challenges. First, since features of all classes share a finite latent space, excessively dispersed base-class features limit the capacity for novel classes. Second, the limited information provided by image-level labels inevitably leads to low-quality pseudo labels, which not only hinders the learning of novel classes but also exacerbates catastrophic forgetting. To address these issues, we propose two strategies: Feature Distribution Regularization (FDR) and Pseudo Label Refinement (PLR), which are applied on the base and incremental steps, respectively. FDR employs Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) to model the feature distribution of each base class, and enforces each feature to approach the center of its corresponding class's GMMs, thereby making the feature distribution of base classes more compact and reserving sufficient space for novel classes. PLR improves pseudo labels from two perspectives. First, it proposes a Prototype Classification Loss (Lpcl )to ensure each prototype is correctly assigned to its corresponding class, which is beneficial for enlarging inter-class differences and helps mitigate the inter-class confusion in pseudo labels. Second, it leverages the predictions of EMA model to adaptively refurbish the pseudo labels, as the EMA model is inherently robust to noise. The effective integration of these two methods not only facilitates the learning of novel classes but also helps mitigate catastrophic forgetting. Extensive experiments conducted on PASCAL and COCO datasets validate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WILSS（弱监督增量学习语义分割）方法，通过特征分布正则化（FDR）和伪标签细化（PLR）策略，解决基类特征过度分散和伪标签质量低的问题，在PASCAL和COCO数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何在仅使用图像级标签的弱监督条件下，实现语义分割的增量学习，同时避免灾难性遗忘？
AI.motivation: WILSS面临两个主要挑战：1）基类特征过度分散限制了新类别的学习空间；2）图像级标签信息有限导致伪标签质量低，既阻碍新类别学习又加剧灾难性遗忘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于弱监督学习、增量学习和语义分割理论，结合高斯混合模型（GMMs）进行特征分布建模，以及原型学习和指数移动平均（EMA）模型的噪声鲁棒性理论。
AI.method: 提出两种策略：1）特征分布正则化（FDR）- 在基类学习阶段使用GMMs建模特征分布，使基类特征更紧凑；2）伪标签细化（PLR）- 在增量阶段使用原型分类损失和EMA模型预测自适应优化伪标签。
AI.findings: FDR使基类特征分布更紧凑，为新类别预留空间；PLR通过原型分类损失增大类间差异，利用EMA模型噪声鲁棒性优化伪标签，有效促进新类别学习并减轻灾难性遗忘。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出特征紧凑化理论，通过GMMs正则化优化特征空间分配；2）建立伪标签质量提升框架，结合原型学习和EMA模型噪声鲁棒性；3）为弱监督增量学习提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了实用的WILSS框架，可在实际应用中逐步学习新类别；2）在PASCAL和COCO数据集上验证了方法的有效性；3）为弱监督语义分割的增量学习提供了可复现的解决方案。

title: Coupling Time-Series Reconstruction with Neural Networks for Chlorophyll-a Gap Filling in Urban Rivers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Zhejiang Normal University, Zhejiang Normal University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Zhejiang Normal University, Wuyi University and The Education University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Coupling Time-Series Reconstruction with Neural Networks for Chlorophyll-a Gap Filling in Urban Rivers
detail.abstract: AbstractsChlorophyll a (Chl-a) is a widely used ecological indicator of algal biomass and eutrophication, and its continuous monitoring is essential for algal-bloom early warning and water-quality management. However, online sensors are frequently affected by environmental disturbances and performance degradation, resulting in data gaps. To address this challenge, model-based approaches have been increasingly applied to restore missing observations and maintain indicator continuity. Yet, strong hydrodynamic fluctuations and non-stationary water-quality dynamics in rivers make accurate Chl-a prediction particularly challenging. In this study, a typical urban river in China was selected as a case study. Three temporal databases were constructed—daily mean (Daily), 7-day moving window mean (Weekly-1), and 7-day interval mean (Weekly-2)—to compare the predictive performance of multiple linear regression (MLR), radial basis function neural network (RBFNN), and back-propagation neural network (BPNN) models. Results showed that models developed using the Weekly-1 time series achieved the best predictive performance, with the BPNN (RMSE = 1.68 μg/L, prediction accuracy (N25) = 89%) and RBFNN (RMSE = 2.27 μg/L, N25 = 78%) markedly outperforming the MLR model (RMSE = 6.43 μg/L, N25 = 36%). Prediction performance improved at higher Chl-a concentrations, indicating enhanced model reliability under elevated bloom risk. Independent validation using an unseen dataset further demonstrated that the optimal BPNN model can reliably reconstruct a 30-day Chl-a data gap under realistic monitoring conditions (RMSE = 1.97 μg/L, N25 = 90%). Overall, the proposed time-series reconstruction–ANN coupling provides a robust and transferable framework for Chl-a gap filling and providing robust support for eutrophication risk assessment in rivers.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对河流叶绿素a在线监测数据缺失问题，通过构建三种时间序列数据库，比较了多种预测模型性能，发现基于7天移动窗口均值的BPNN模型在叶绿素a数据填补方面表现最佳，为河流富营养化风险评估提供了可靠支持。
AI.research_question: 如何有效填补河流叶绿素a在线监测数据缺失，特别是在强水动力波动和非稳态水质动态条件下？
AI.motivation: 叶绿素a是藻类生物量和富营养化的重要生态指标，但在线传感器常受环境干扰和性能退化影响导致数据缺失，影响藻华预警和水质管理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间序列分析、人工神经网络（BPNN、RBFNN）、多元线性回归等预测模型理论。
AI.method: 以中国典型城市河流为案例，构建三种时间序列数据库（日平均、7天移动窗口平均、7天间隔平均），比较MLR、RBFNN和BPNN模型的预测性能，并使用独立数据集验证最优模型。
AI.findings: 基于7天移动窗口均值的模型表现最佳，BPNN（RMSE=1.68μg/L，N25=89%）和RBFNN（RMSE=2.27μg/L，N25=78%）显著优于MLR（RMSE=6.43μg/L，N25=36%）；叶绿素a浓度越高预测性能越好；最优BPNN模型能可靠重建30天数据缺失（RMSE=1.97μg/L，N25=90%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了时间序列重构-人工神经网络耦合框架，为河流叶绿素a数据填补提供了理论方法；证明了在强水动力波动条件下，适当的时间序列处理能显著提升模型预测性能。
AI.practical_contributions: 为河流叶绿素a在线监测数据缺失问题提供了实用的填补方案；为藻华早期预警和水质管理提供了可靠技术支持；该框架具有可移植性，可应用于其他河流的富营养化风险评估。

title: PAMA: Dual-Memory Augmentation Assisted Pseudo-Anomaly Contrastive Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Hebei University and Hebei University

detail.title: PAMA: Dual-Memory Augmentation Assisted Pseudo-Anomaly Contrastive Learning for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
detail.abstract: For multivariate time series anomaly detection, most methods assume that training data are clean and ignore the characteristics of anomalous data. They often suffer from the overgeneralization problem during the reconstruction process. To address these problems, dual-memory augmentation assisted pseudo-anomaly contrastive learning for multivariate time series anomaly detection (shorted as PAMA) is proposed. First, the prior knowledge of anomalies is utilized to generate pseudo anomalies from the original time series. The normal and pseudo-anomalous feature representations that contain global and local information are respectively achieved by the global and local encoders. Two independent memory modules are constructed to further memorize normal and pseudo-anomalous prototypes. Second, a dual-memory augmentation mechanism is proposed to conduct data augmentation upon the normal and pseudo-anomalous feature representations and then obtain the memory-augmented feature representations. Third, the pseudo-anomaly contrastive learning is proposed to perform temporal contrastive learning and instance contrastive learning on the obtained memory-augmented representations. Compared with the fourteen baseline methods, the experimental results demonstrate that PAMA achieves the optimal detection performance.

AI.tldr: PAMA提出了一种双记忆增强辅助的伪异常对比学习方法，用于多元时间序列异常检测。该方法利用异常先验知识生成伪异常，通过全局和局部编码器提取特征，构建独立记忆模块存储正常和异常原型，通过记忆增强机制和伪异常对比学习提升检测性能。
AI.research_question: 如何解决多元时间序列异常检测中训练数据不干净、异常数据特性被忽略以及重构过程中的过度泛化问题？
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常假设训练数据是干净的，忽略了异常数据的特性，在重构过程中容易出现过拟合问题，需要一种能够有效利用异常先验知识并避免过度泛化的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于对比学习理论，结合异常检测的特定需求，构建了双记忆模块架构，包括正常和伪异常特征的原型记忆，以及记忆增强机制。
AI.method: 1. 利用异常先验知识从原始时间序列生成伪异常；2. 通过全局和局部编码器分别提取正常和伪异常特征；3. 构建独立记忆模块存储正常和异常原型；4. 提出双记忆增强机制进行数据增强；5. 进行伪异常对比学习，包括时间对比学习和实例对比学习。
AI.findings: 与14个基线方法相比，PAMA在多元时间序列异常检测任务中取得了最优的检测性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了双记忆增强机制；2. 提出了伪异常对比学习方法；3. 将异常先验知识整合到对比学习框架中；4. 解决了过度泛化问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了PAMA系统，可用于实际多元时间序列异常检测；2. 提供了处理不干净训练数据的有效方法；3. 在多个基准数据集上验证了方法的有效性。

title: Nonparametric Predictive Inference for Ranking and Selection using Loss Functions
affiliations: King Abdulaziz University, Durham University and Durham University

detail.title: Nonparametric Predictive Inference for Ranking and Selection using Loss Functions
detail.abstract: Selection and ranking of multiple groups are fundamental problems in many scientific and practical applications, where decisions must be made under uncertainty about future outcomes. This paper develops a Nonparametric Predictive Inference (NPI) framework for ranking and selection using loss functions to quantify the consequences of suboptimal decisions. Uncertainty is quantified through NPI lower and upper expected losses, capturing the imprecision inherent in predictive inference under minimal modelling assumptions. For selection problems, zero–one, linear, and quadratic loss functions are applied in both pairwise and multiple comparison settings, covering events such as selecting the best group, selecting a subset of best groups, and selecting a subset that contains the best group. For ranking problems, zero–one and general multi-level loss functions are introduced for ranked subsets of the best groups. While the zero–one loss provides a binary assessment of correctness, the multi-level loss assigns graded penalties according to the severity of ranking errors. The framework is further extended to general selection-and-ranking events in which groups are allocated to ordered buckets. Examples indicate that zero–one, linear, and quadratic loss functions often agree in overall conclusions, while linear, quadratic, and multi-level losses offer a more informative assessment of suboptimal selections and ranking errors. The findings highlight the importance of careful loss specification and demonstrate the usefulness of NPI lower and upper expected losses for ranking and selection under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于损失函数的非参数预测推理（NPI）框架，用于在不确定性下进行群体选择和排序，通过上下界期望损失量化决策后果。
AI.research_question: 如何在最小建模假设下，使用非参数预测推理框架和损失函数来解决多群体选择和排序问题？
AI.motivation: 多群体选择和排序是许多科学和实际应用中的基本问题，需要在未来结果不确定的情况下做出决策。现有方法需要更灵活地量化次优决策的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数预测推理（NPI）理论框架，使用下界和上界期望损失来量化不确定性，涵盖零一损失、线性损失、二次损失和多级损失函数。
AI.method: 开发NPI框架应用于选择和排序问题：对于选择问题，使用零一、线性和二次损失函数；对于排序问题，引入零一和多级损失函数；进一步扩展到有序桶分配的一般选择-排序事件。
AI.findings: 零一、线性和二次损失函数在总体结论上通常一致，而线性、二次和多级损失能提供更丰富的次优选择和排序错误评估信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了基于损失函数的NPI选择和排序理论框架；2）提出了量化不确定性的下界和上界期望损失方法；3）扩展了从二元评估到分级惩罚的损失函数体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为实际决策者提供了在不确定性下进行选择和排序的系统方法；2）展示了不同损失函数在评估决策后果时的适用场景；3）强调了损失函数规范在决策分析中的重要性。

title: Orthogonalized Multimodal Contrastive Learning with Asymmetric Masking for Structured Representations
affiliations: Hannover Medical School, Hannover Medical School and L3S Research Center

detail.title: Orthogonalized Multimodal Contrastive Learning with Asymmetric Masking for Structured Representations
detail.abstract: Multimodal learning seeks to integrate information from heterogeneous sources, where signals may be shared across modalities, specific to individual modalities, or emerge only through their interaction. While self-supervised multimodal contrastive learning has achieved remarkable progress, most existing methods predominantly capture redundant cross-modal signals, often neglecting modality-specific (unique) and interaction-driven (synergistic) information. Recent extensions broaden this perspective, yet they either fail to explicitly model synergistic interactions or learn different information components in an entangled manner, leading to incomplete representations and potential information leakage.We introduce \textbf{COrAL}, a principled framework that explicitly and simultaneously preserves redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal representations. COrAL employs a dual-path architecture with orthogonality constraints to disentangle shared and modality-specific features, ensuring a clean separation of information components. To promote synergy modeling, we introduce asymmetric masking with complementary view-specific patterns, compelling the model to infer cross-modal dependencies rather than rely solely on redundant cues. Extensive experiments on synthetic benchmarks and diverse MultiBench datasets demonstrate that COrAL consistently matches or outperforms state-of-the-art methods while exhibiting low performance variance across runs. These results indicate that explicitly modeling the full spectrum of multimodal information yields more stable, reliable, and comprehensive embeddings\footnote{Code is available at: \url{https://github.com/Caro-Ci/COrAL}}.

AI.tldr: COrAL是一个多模态学习框架，通过正交约束和不对称掩码技术，显式地同时保留冗余、独特和协同信息，实现更稳定、可靠和全面的多模态表征。
AI.research_question: 如何显式地同时建模多模态数据中的冗余信息、模态特定信息和协同交互信息，以获得更完整、稳定的多模态表征？
AI.motivation: 现有自监督多模态对比学习方法主要捕捉冗余的跨模态信号，往往忽视模态特定信息和协同交互信息，导致表征不完整和潜在信息泄露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息论的多模态信息分解理论，将多模态信息分为冗余信息、独特信息和协同信息三种类型。
AI.method: COrAL采用双路径架构，通过正交约束解耦共享特征和模态特定特征；引入不对称掩码技术，强制模型推断跨模态依赖关系而非仅依赖冗余线索。
AI.findings: 在合成基准测试和多样化的MultiBench数据集上，COrAL始终匹配或优于最先进方法，同时表现出较低的性能方差，表明显式建模完整多模态信息谱系能产生更稳定、可靠和全面的嵌入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个原则性框架，首次显式地同时保留冗余、独特和协同信息；发展了正交约束和不对称掩码技术来解耦信息成分和促进协同建模。
AI.practical_contributions: COrAL框架在多个数据集上表现优异且稳定；开源代码便于复现和应用；为多模态学习提供了更全面的表征学习解决方案。

title: LGBE-MSA: Language-Guided Bidirectional Encoder for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
affiliations: Heilongjiang University, Heilongjiang University, Guizhou University, Guizhou University, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin Institute of Technology and Harbin Institute of Technology

detail.title: LGBE-MSA: Language-Guided Bidirectional Encoder for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

keywords.keywords: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis；Language-Guided Bidirectional Encoder；Linguistically-Guided Evidence Maskings

detail.abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis aims to fuse textual, acoustic, and visual information to characterize fine-grained affective states. However, existing approaches typically rely on fixed fusion architectures and a single prediction head, which makes it difficult to maintain stable, expressive modeling capacity across varying languages, modalities, and noise conditions. To address this limitation, we propose a unified and adaptive framework for multimodal sentiment analysis(LGBE-MSA) that jointly supports deep cross-modal modeling and dataset-level flexibility within a shared representation space. At its core lies a Language-Guided Bidirectional Encoder(LGBE), which performs multi-layer pre-normalized cross-modal interactions, performing text-to-audio, text-to-visual, and optional audio-visual bidirectional attention to enable progressive fusion from lexical cues to semantic abstractions. Simultaneously, Linguistically-Guided Evidence Maskings(LiGEM) exploits language-modality similarity to adaptively suppress unreliable modalities and enhance information flow between complementary ones. We further introduce lightweight dataset-specific adaptations to balance model complexity and performance across benchmarks. Experimental results on multiple sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed unified adaptive framework yields substantial gains in both regression and classification metrics and exhibits strong generalization and stability across different languages and modalities.

AI.tldr: LGBE-MSA是一个统一的自适应多模态情感分析框架，通过语言引导的双向编码器和语言引导的证据掩码，实现跨模态渐进融合和不可靠模态自适应抑制，在多个基准测试中显著提升性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个统一且自适应的多模态情感分析框架，能够在不同语言、模态和噪声条件下保持稳定的表达能力？
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常依赖固定的融合架构和单一预测头，难以在不同语言、模态和噪声条件下保持稳定且富有表达力的建模能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言引导的多模态融合理论，跨模态渐进融合理论，自适应模态抑制理论
AI.method: 1. 语言引导双向编码器(LGBE)：执行多层预归一化跨模态交互，包括文本-音频、文本-视觉和可选的音频-视觉双向注意力机制，实现从词汇线索到语义抽象的渐进融合。2. 语言引导证据掩码(LiGEM)：利用语言-模态相似性自适应抑制不可靠模态，增强互补模态间的信息流。3. 轻量级数据集特定适配：平衡模型复杂性和性能。
AI.findings: 在多个情感分析基准测试中，提出的统一自适应框架在回归和分类指标上都取得了显著提升，并在不同语言和模态上表现出强大的泛化能力和稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了语言引导的跨模态融合理论框架。2. 发展了自适应模态抑制的理论基础。3. 建立了统一的多模态情感分析理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了LGBE-MSA框架，可应用于实际多模态情感分析任务。2. 提供了数据集特定的轻量级适配方案。3. 在不同语言和模态条件下具有更好的稳定性和泛化能力。

title: A Taxonomy of Interpretable Neurosymbolic Models for Time Series
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Strasbourg - ICUBE Laboratory UMR CNRS 7357, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Strasbourg

detail.title: A Taxonomy of Interpretable Neurosymbolic Models for Time Series
detail.abstract: Time series classification (TSC) with deep learning has advanced markedly over the last decade, yet the mechanisms by which models identify and exploit discriminative patterns remain only partially understood, limiting interpretability. This paper surveys neuro-symbolic approaches that aim either (i) to derive knowledge—by extracting human-readable rules and explanations from data—or (ii) to use knowledge—by injecting logical, physical, or structural constraints into learning. We review methods spanning Signal Temporal Logic (STL) formula extraction and temporal decision trees, neuro-symbolic constraint synthesis and circuits, loss-based regularization including physics-informed objectives, probabilistic logic for event reasoning (e.g., DeepProbLog), and concept-level continual learning and distillation. We position these methods along common axes—explicit vs. implicit knowledge, applicability to TSC, capacity for knowledge discovery, prior knowledge requirements, and reproducibility—and discuss typical failure modes, including data bias and reasoning shortcuts. We also relate recent frugalityoriented designs that leverage non-trainable filters without sacrificing accuracy. Our analysis indicates that neurosymbolic techniques can provide actionable explanations and stronger inductive bias, with especially strong results on binary tasks, but face challenges in scaling to multi-class settings, handling shape-dependent phenomena, and ensuring transparent selection of learned rules. The survey offers a taxonomy and practical guidance for integrating symbolic structure with deep learning in TSC, highlighting open problems and promising directions.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文综述了时间序列分类中的神经符号方法，包括从数据中提取可解释规则和向学习中注入约束两种主要途径，分析了这些方法的优势、挑战及未来方向。
AI.research_question: 如何通过神经符号方法提高时间序列分类模型的可解释性？具体包括如何从数据中提取人类可读的规则和解释，以及如何向学习过程中注入逻辑、物理或结构约束？
AI.motivation: 尽管深度学习在时间序列分类方面取得了显著进展，但模型识别和利用判别模式的机制仍然不完全清楚，这限制了模型的可解释性。需要探索能够提供可解释性和更强归纳偏置的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经符号计算框架，包括信号时序逻辑公式提取、时序决策树、神经符号约束合成与电路、基于损失的规则化（如物理信息目标）、概率逻辑（如DeepProbLog）、概念级持续学习和蒸馏等理论。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统回顾神经符号方法在时间序列分类中的应用，按照显式vs隐式知识、TSC适用性、知识发现能力、先验知识需求、可复现性等维度进行分类分析。
AI.findings: 神经符号技术可以提供可操作的解释和更强的归纳偏置，在二元任务上表现尤其出色，但在扩展到多类别设置、处理形状相关现象、确保学习规则透明选择等方面面临挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了神经符号方法在时间序列分类中的分类法，明确了不同方法的理论定位，识别了典型失败模式（如数据偏见和推理捷径），并指出了开放问题和研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在时间序列分类中整合符号结构和深度学习提供了实用指导，包括利用非可训练滤波器而不牺牲准确性的节俭设计，以及实际应用中的注意事项。

title: Multi-mode Fractional Weibull Process Model for Remaining Useful Life Prognosis of IGBT under DC Voltage Control
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Irkutsk National Research Technical University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multi-mode Fractional Weibull Process Model for Remaining Useful Life Prognosis of IGBT under DC Voltage Control
detail.abstract: IGBTs often operate under stochastic external conditions, and their degradation process is slow, progressive, non-stationary, and characterized by long-range dependence. In particular, an IGBT may switch randomly among three operating modes: active mode, saturation mode, and cut-off mode. Consequently, predicting the remaining useful life becomes highly challenging. In this study, a complex health indicator is first proposed as a failure parameter to identify fault features, constructed through a weighted linear combination of the gate voltage, collector voltage and temperature. Next, a fractional Weibull process model incorporating long-range dependence is developed, which accounts for the three operating modes corresponding to the cut-off, saturation, and active regions of the IGBT. Finally, the experimental dataset is obtained from the publicly available thermal overload aging data of power IGBTs provided by the NASA Research Center. The results show that the proposed approach achieves higher prognosis accuracy compared to four other prognostic optimization strategies, as confirmed through error analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种结合复杂健康指标和分数Weibull过程模型的IGBT剩余寿命预测方法，考虑了IGBT在截止、饱和和放大三种工作模式下的随机切换特性，相比其他四种预测策略具有更高的准确性。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测在随机外部条件和三种工作模式切换下运行的IGBT的剩余使用寿命？
AI.motivation: IGBT的退化过程缓慢、渐进、非平稳且具有长程依赖性，同时可能在截止、饱和和放大三种工作模式间随机切换，这使得剩余寿命预测变得极具挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 复杂健康指标理论：通过门极电压、集电极电压和温度的加权线性组合构建故障特征参数
2. 分数Weibull过程模型：结合长程依赖性的退化过程建模理论
3. IGBT三种工作模式理论：截止区、饱和区和放大区的工作特性
AI.method:
1. 提出复杂健康指标作为故障参数
2. 开发包含长程依赖性的分数Weibull过程模型，考虑IGBT的三种工作模式
3. 使用NASA研究中心提供的功率IGBT热过载老化公开数据集进行实验验证
4. 与四种其他预测优化策略进行对比分析
AI.findings:
1. 提出的方法能够有效识别IGBT的故障特征
2. 分数Weibull过程模型能够很好地描述具有长程依赖性的退化过程
3. 该方法相比其他四种预测策略具有更高的预测准确性
4. 误差分析证实了该方法的优越性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了适用于IGBT退化过程建模的复杂健康指标构建方法
2. 开发了考虑长程依赖性和多种工作模式的分数Weibull过程模型
3. 为随机外部条件下运行的电力电子器件寿命预测提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为IGBT的剩余寿命预测提供了更准确的工程方法
2. 可用于电力电子系统的预防性维护和可靠性评估
3. 基于公开数据集验证了方法的有效性，具有实际应用价值
4. 相比现有方法提高了预测精度，有助于降低系统故障风险

title: Supply Shocks and Persistent Price Effects: Evidence from the U.S. Used Car CPI during Covid-19
affiliations: University of Maine, University of Maine, University of Maine and University of Maine

detail.title: Supply Shocks and Persistent Price Effects: Evidence from the U.S. Used Car CPI during Covid-19
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of COVID-19 related supply disruptions on the U.S. used vehicle market using monthly Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for used cars and trucks from January 2000 to December 2025. This study employs a counterfactual ARIMA(1,1,0) forecasting approach to quantify the magnitude and persistence of pandemic induced price effects in the used car sector. We train a model on pre-pandemic data (2000–2019) and generate counterfactual forecasts representing the hypothetical no-pandemic scenario. Our findings reveal that used car prices peaked at 53.9% above the counterfactual trend in February 2022, with an average elevation of 28.8% throughout 2020 – 2025. Critically, prices remained 29.5% above trend in the 2024–2025 period, demonstrating remarkable persistence five years post-shock. These results provide novel empirical evidence of long-run price rigidity following acute supply disruptions, with implications for inflation forecasting, monetary policy, and understanding sectoral shock propagation in production networks. The study addresses a significant gap in the literature by providing one of the first counterfactual ARIMA analysis of used car price persistence extending through 2025.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用反事实ARIMA模型分析COVID-19供应链中断对美国二手车市场的影响，发现二手车价格在2022年2月达到峰值，比反事实趋势高出53.9%，2020-2025年平均高出28.8%，且2024-2025年仍高出29.5%，显示出显著的长期价格刚性。
AI.research_question: COVID-19相关的供应链中断对美国二手车市场的价格影响有多大？这种价格效应具有怎样的持续性和长期影响？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行导致全球供应链严重中断，但学术界对特定行业（如二手车市场）价格效应的长期持续性缺乏系统研究，特别是缺乏使用反事实方法量化分析的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价格刚性理论、供应链冲击传导理论、反事实分析框架、ARIMA时间序列预测模型。
AI.method: 使用2000年1月至2025年12月的月度CPI数据，采用反事实ARIMA(1,1,0)预测方法，基于疫情前数据（2000-2019年）训练模型，生成假设无疫情情况下的反事实预测。
AI.findings: 1. 二手车价格在2022年2月达到峰值，比反事实趋势高出53.9%；2. 2020-2025年平均价格比反事实趋势高出28.8%；3. 2024-2025年价格仍高出29.5%，显示五年后价格效应仍显著持续。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为供应链冲击后的长期价格刚性提供了新颖的经验证据；2. 扩展了反事实ARIMA方法在价格持续性分析中的应用；3. 增进了对生产网络中部门冲击传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对通货膨胀预测具有重要启示；2. 为货币政策制定提供参考依据；3. 帮助企业和政策制定者更好地理解供应链冲击的长期经济影响。

title: Hydrogen Fuels for Industrial Decarbonisation: Energy System Analysis for the Case of the Lime Industry using a Reference Plant Approach
affiliations: Ruhr University Bochum, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Ruhr University of Bochum

detail.title: Hydrogen Fuels for Industrial Decarbonisation: Energy System Analysis for the Case of the Lime Industry using a Reference Plant Approach
detail.abstract: Decarbonising high-temperature, energy‑intensive industries is a key challenge for achieving net-zero emissions. The lime sector with its core calcination step (> 900°C) exemplifies this challenge. While green hydrogen is widely discussed as a substitute fuel, the lime industry lacks a representative plant-level system definition, that enables the analysis of hydrogen use. (i) We  define the energy and material flows of a reference lime plant and (ii) develop a cost‑minimising energy system model using the open‑source modelling framework Backbone. The model represents the main production steps, allows investments in hydrogen infrastructure, and is evaluated across scenarios with varying energy‑carrier prices, carbon allowance prices, and price volatilities. Calcination accounts for over 95% of total energy demand. Therefore, meaningful decarbonisation must target this process. Hydrogen becomes a cost‑efficient substitute for natural gas only with high carbon prices and hydrogen prices below 100€/MWh, under stable gas prices. Exploiting price fluctuations through flexible production and storage reduces system costs and can enable a transitional phase with co‑use of natural gas and hydrogen. A full switch to hydrogen reduces the total greenhouse gas emissions by 27% compared to a gas‑fired plant by removing energy‑related emissions. This work provides a reference plant definition and an open‑source modelling basis that identifies economic conditions for hydrogen use.

AI.tldr: 该研究定义了石灰厂的参考系统模型，分析氢能作为高温工业脱碳方案的经济条件，发现氢能仅在特定碳价和氢价条件下具有成本效益，且灵活生产能降低系统成本。
AI.research_question: 在石灰工业中，氢能作为高温煅烧过程脱碳燃料的经济可行性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 高温能源密集型工业脱碳是实现净零排放的关键挑战，石灰行业煅烧过程(>900°C)是典型代表，但目前缺乏分析氢能应用的工厂级系统定义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源系统建模理论，成本最小化优化框架，脱碳技术经济分析理论。
AI.method: 1) 定义参考石灰厂的能源和物料流；2) 使用开源建模框架Backbone开发成本最小化能源系统模型；3) 在不同能源载体价格、碳配额价格和价格波动性情景下评估模型。
AI.findings: 1) 煅烧过程占总能耗95%以上，是脱碳关键目标；2) 氢能仅在碳价高且氢价低于100€/MWh时具有成本效益；3) 利用价格波动的灵活生产和储存可降低系统成本，支持天然气和氢能过渡性共用；4) 完全转向氢能可减少27%温室气体排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了石灰工业氢能应用的参考工厂定义和开源建模基础，建立了分析高温工业脱碳技术经济可行性的系统框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为石灰行业决策者提供了氢能应用的经济条件评估工具，识别了实现氢能转型所需的碳价和氢价阈值，支持行业脱碳路径规划。

title: Reservoir Parameter Inversion and Gas Channeling Identification for CO2 Flooding Based on a Dual Surrogate-Assisted Differential Evolution Algorithm
affiliations: Yangtze University, Yangtze University, Yangtze University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Yangtze University

detail.title: Reservoir Parameter Inversion and Gas Channeling Identification for CO2 Flooding Based on a Dual Surrogate-Assisted Differential Evolution Algorithm
detail.abstract: Amidst the dual pressures of global climate change and surging energy demand, Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage paired with Enhanced Oil Recovery (CCUS-EOR) is crucial for carbon neutrality. However, severe CO2 gas channeling often triggers massive invalid gas cycling, which drastically degrades the energy conversion efficiency of the system and threatens carbon storage security. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel methodology for reservoir parameter inversion and gas channeling identification based on a Dual Surrogate-Assisted Differential Evolution Algorithm (DS-DE). By incorporating a dual-surrogate mechanism utilizing General Regression Neural Network (GRNN) and Radial Basis Function (RBF), the proposed method significantly reduces the computational cost associated with numerical simulations. Compared to the standard Differential Evolution (DE) and Single Surrogate-Assisted DE (SA-DE) algorithms, the DS-DE algorithm reduces computational time by approximately 70%-73% and 47%-51%, respectively, while maintaining high inversion accuracy. Based on the inversion results from a conceptual model, six distinct flow regimes during the CO2 displacement process were identified through pressure-transient analysis. Specifically, the presence of gas channeling was diagnosed by the characteristic linear flow regime (with a derivative slope of 0.5) in the transition zone. Furthermore, the propagation distance of the gas channeling front was quantitatively calculated using the investigation radius equation, showing excellent agreement with numerical simulation results. Sensitivity analysis reveals that reservoir petrophysical properties, parameters of high-permeability channels, and heterogeneity are the dominant factors controlling pressure responses. The method demonstrates robust performance in heterogeneous reservoirs, with inversion errors consistently below 7%. Field application at Well X4 in a CO2 sequestration demonstration zone validated the algorithm's effectiveness. Even in the presence of strong geological heterogeneity, the relative inversion error of geological parameters was controlled within 8%, and a gas channeling pathway of 228 m was successfully identified (in close agreement with the field monitoring result of 250 m). This research not only provides a cost-effective dynamic monitoring tool to mitigate invalid energy consumption but also offers a quantitative scientific basis for ensuring carbon storage security and optimizing overall energy management in CCUS projects.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于双代理辅助差分进化算法（DS-DE）的新方法，用于油藏参数反演和CO2气窜识别，显著降低了数值模拟计算成本，为CCUS-EOR项目提供了有效的动态监测工具。
AI.research_question: 如何有效识别和量化CCUS-EOR过程中的CO2气窜现象，同时降低油藏参数反演的计算成本？
AI.motivation: 在全球气候变化和能源需求激增的双重压力下，CCUS-EOR对碳中和至关重要。然而，严重的CO2气窜会导致大量无效气体循环，大幅降低系统能量转换效率并威胁碳封存安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双代理辅助差分进化算法（DS-DE），结合广义回归神经网络（GRNN）和径向基函数（RBF）的双代理机制，以及压力瞬变分析理论。
AI.method: 提出DS-DE算法进行油藏参数反演，通过压力瞬变分析识别CO2驱替过程中的六种流动状态，利用探测半径方程定量计算气窜前缘传播距离。
AI.findings: DS-DE算法比标准DE和单代理辅助DE分别减少计算时间70%-73%和47%-51%，反演误差低于7%；识别出线性流动状态（导数斜率0.5）作为气窜特征；在强非均质性条件下，地质参数反演误差控制在8%以内，成功识别228米气窜通道（与现场监测250米吻合）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）发展了双代理辅助优化算法理论；2）建立了基于压力瞬变分析的气窜识别理论框架；3）提出了气窜前缘定量计算方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为CCUS-EOR项目提供成本效益高的动态监测工具；2）为碳封存安全提供定量科学依据；3）有助于优化整体能源管理，减少无效能耗。

title: Factors Affecting Purchase Intention of Electric Vehicles with Tax Incentives as a Moderator
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Factors Affecting Purchase Intention of Electric Vehicles with Tax Incentives as a Moderator
detail.abstract: This study examines the factors influencing Electric Vehicle (EV) purchase intention in Indonesia, with Tax Incentives as a moderating variable. It adopts a quantitative approach by collecting data through questionnaires and analyzing the data using Stata software, the study tests the effects of Price Value, Technology Awareness, and Charging Infrastructure on EV purchase interest. Results show that Technology Awareness is the most dominant driver (coefficient 0.610, P=0.005), followed by Price Value (coefficient 0.323, P=0.020). Charging Infrastructure and Tax Incentives did not show significant direct effects on purchase interest. Although Tax Incentives significantly strengthened the perception of Technology Awareness (P=0.002), their mediating role on purchase interest was insignificant (P=0.137). These findings suggest that strategies to accelerate EV adoption should focus on technology education and product value enhancement rather than relying solely on fiscal incentive policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨影响印尼电动汽车购买意愿的因素，以税收激励为调节变量。研究发现技术意识是最主要驱动因素，其次是价格价值，而充电基础设施和税收激励的直接效应不显著。
AI.research_question: 在印尼，价格价值、技术意识和充电基础设施如何影响电动汽车购买意愿？税收激励在其中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 随着全球向可持续交通转型，了解印尼市场电动汽车采用的关键驱动因素对于制定有效政策至关重要，特别是税收激励政策的效果需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和技术接受模型，研究价格价值、技术意识、充电基础设施对购买意愿的影响，并引入税收激励作为调节变量。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，通过问卷调查收集数据，使用Stata软件进行统计分析，检验各变量对电动汽车购买意愿的影响。
AI.findings: 技术意识是最主要驱动因素（系数0.610，P=0.005），其次是价格价值（系数0.323，P=0.020）。充电基础设施和税收激励的直接效应不显著。税收激励显著增强了技术意识的感知（P=0.002），但对购买意愿的调节作用不显著（P=0.137）。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了技术接受模型在电动汽车领域的应用，揭示了在发展中国家市场中技术意识比基础设施和财政激励更重要的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼政府和汽车制造商提供政策建议：应优先投资于技术教育和产品价值提升，而非单纯依赖财政激励政策来促进电动汽车采用。

title: What Causes the Discrepancies Between Scheduled and Actual Flight Block Times? Evidence from U.S. Domestic Airline Operations
affiliations: Kent State University, Purdue University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Purdue University

detail.title: What Causes the Discrepancies Between Scheduled and Actual Flight Block Times? Evidence from U.S. Domestic Airline Operations
detail.abstract: Scheduled block time (SBT) represents the planned gate-to-gate duration of a flight and serves as a key element of airline schedule planning. In practice, actual block times (ABT) frequently differ from scheduled values due to operational and environmental conditions. This study investigates the determinants of relative block time discrepancy between ABT and SBT using a dataset of approximately 7.13 million U.S. domestic flights in 2024, integrating flight operations data with airport characteristics, aircraft information, weather observations, and airport traffic measures. The analysis combines descriptive exploration with multiple empirical modeling approaches, including robust linear regression, LASSO regression, multivariate adaptive regression splines (MARS), generalized additive models (GAM), Random Forest, and XGBoost. Results reveal systematic patterns in block time discrepancies across time of day, airport hub categories, and aircraft types. Weather conditions, particularly precipitation, temperature, wind speed, and visibility, and airport traffic levels emerge as consistent determinants across modeling approaches. Regional jet operations show greater sensitivity to weather conditions, while congestion-related factors play a stronger role in wide-body operations. Machine learning models further improve predictive performance relative to traditional statistical approaches by capturing nonlinear interactions among operational and environmental variables. Overall, the findings provide large-scale empirical evidence on the operational drivers of discrepancies between scheduled and actual block times and offer insights for improving airline schedule planning and operational performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2024年713万次美国国内航班数据，分析实际飞行时间与计划飞行时间差异的决定因素，发现天气条件、机场交通水平、航班时段、机场枢纽类别和机型等系统性影响因素，机器学习模型相比传统统计方法能更好地预测这些差异。
AI.research_question: 实际飞行时间与计划飞行时间差异的决定因素是什么？这些差异在不同运营和环境条件下如何变化？
AI.motivation: 计划飞行时间是航空公司航班计划的关键要素，但实际飞行时间经常因运营和环境条件而偏离计划值。理解这些差异的决定因素对于改进航空公司航班计划和运营绩效至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合航班运营理论、机场运营管理、天气对航空运营影响理论，以及机器学习预测模型理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2024年约713万次美国国内航班数据，整合航班运营数据、机场特征、飞机信息、天气观测和机场交通指标。采用描述性探索与多种实证建模方法，包括稳健线性回归、LASSO回归、MARS、GAM、随机森林和XGBoost。
AI.findings: 发现航班时段、机场枢纽类别和机型存在系统性差异模式。天气条件（特别是降水、温度、风速和能见度）和机场交通水平是各建模方法中一致的决定因素。支线喷气机运营对天气条件更敏感，而拥堵相关因素在宽体机运营中作用更强。机器学习模型通过捕捉运营和环境变量间的非线性交互作用，相比传统统计方法提高了预测性能。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于计划与实际飞行时间差异运营驱动因素的大规模实证证据，扩展了航空运营管理理论，特别是关于天气、拥堵和机型差异对航班时间影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为改进航空公司航班计划制定和运营绩效提供了具体见解，帮助航空公司更准确地预测飞行时间，优化航班计划，减少延误，提高运营效率。

title: The Duality of Urban Logistics Facilities: Identifying Unobserved Heterogeneity in Public Acceptance and Residential Satisfaction
affiliations: Inha University and Inha University

detail.title: The Duality of Urban Logistics Facilities: Identifying Unobserved Heterogeneity in Public Acceptance and Residential Satisfaction
detail.abstract: The outward migration of urban freight infrastructure, known as logistics sprawl, has triggered severe spatial conflicts and NIMBY (Not in My Back Yard) resistance in host communities. While previous literature predominantly examines the operational optimization of these facilities, empirical investigations into the public’s social acceptance remain limited and often assume population homogeneity. This study investigates the multi-level determinants of social acceptance toward urban logistics facilities utilizing a survey of 1,507 residents in Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Employing a multi-stage analytical framework, the research integrates a Binary Logistic Regression (BLR), a Multi-Level Latent Class Model (MLLCM), and a Cumulative Link Mixed Model (CLMM). The BLR results reveal a profound perceptual duality, where localized physical externalities and property value anxieties significantly deter acceptance, whereas anticipated economic benefits strongly drive public support. Moving beyond average estimates, the MLLCM uncovers six distinct latent attitudinal classes, demonstrating that socio-demographic factors, such as age and the presence of preschool children, act as powerful polarizing catalysts. Notably, the integration of regional spatial metrics exposes the phenomenon of "logistics sprawl fatigue". High physical concentrations of warehouses may contribute to shifting communities toward chronic apathy and significantly erode overarching residential satisfaction. These findings underscore the need for tailored community engagement strategies and regional-level zoning thresholds to foster socially sustainable urban freight environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过韩国京畿道1507名居民的调查，采用多阶段分析框架（BLR、MLLCM、CLMM），揭示了城市物流设施社会接受度的多层次决定因素，发现了感知二元性、六种潜在态度类别以及"物流蔓延疲劳"现象。
AI.research_question: 城市物流设施社会接受度的多层次决定因素是什么？如何理解公众对物流设施的态度异质性及其空间分布影响？
AI.motivation: 城市货运基础设施外迁（物流蔓延）引发了严重的空间冲突和邻避抵抗，现有文献主要关注设施运营优化，而对公众社会接受度的实证研究有限且常假设人口同质性，需要更深入探究态度异质性和空间影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会接受度理论、邻避效应理论、空间冲突理论、多层级分析框架（个体-社区-区域）、态度异质性理论
AI.method: 对韩国京畿道1507名居民进行问卷调查，采用多阶段分析框架：二元逻辑回归（BLR）识别关键影响因素，多层级潜在类别模型（MLLCM）揭示态度异质性，累积链接混合模型（CLMM）分析空间效应。
AI.findings: 1. BLR显示感知二元性：局部物理外部性和房产价值担忧显著降低接受度，而预期经济效益强烈驱动公众支持。2. MLLCM识别出六种潜在态度类别，年龄和学龄前儿童等社会人口因素起极化催化作用。3. 区域空间指标整合揭示了"物流蔓延疲劳"现象：高密度仓库集中可能导致社区转向慢性冷漠，显著侵蚀整体居住满意度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 超越平均估计，揭示公众态度的异质性和复杂性。2. 整合多层次分析框架，连接个体态度与区域空间特征。3. 提出"物流蔓延疲劳"概念，丰富空间冲突和社会接受度理论。4. 挑战人口同质性假设，强调社会人口因素的极化作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 需要制定差异化的社区参与策略，针对不同态度群体采取不同干预措施。2. 建议设立区域层面的分区阈值，防止物流设施过度集中。3. 为城市规划者提供实证依据，促进社会可持续的城市货运环境。4. 帮助政策制定者平衡经济效益与社区福祉。

title: Comprehensive Benefit Evaluation and Obstacle Factor Analysis of China's Offshore Aquaculture
affiliations: Ocean University of China, Ocean University of China, Ocean University of China, Guangzhou University, Qingdao Institute of Technology, Ocean University of China, Bangladesh Fisheries Research Institute, Ocean University of China, Ocean University of China and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comprehensive Benefit Evaluation and Obstacle Factor Analysis of China's Offshore Aquaculture
detail.abstract: This study aims to quantitatively evaluate the comprehensive benefits of China's offshore aquaculture from 2008 to 2022 and conduct an in-depth analysis of its development obstacles. To this end, we constructed a comprehensive benefit evaluation indicator system covering ecological, social, and economic dimensions, and employed the CRITIC weighting method, a multi-index comprehensive evaluation model, the Pearson correlation coefficient, and an obstacle degree model for measurement and analysis. The main findings are as follows: During the study period, the comprehensive benefits of the offshore aquaculture industry showed a significant upward trend, experiencing three stages of evolution: "fluctuant exploration → steady recovery → accelerated growth", with recent growth primarily driven by social and economic benefits. Correlation analysis further revealed a significant strong positive correlation between the social benefit index and the economic benefit index (r ≈ 0.815), forming a mutually reinforcing synergistic enhancement mechanism. However, the ecological benefit index showed only a weak correlation with the social benefit index and an extremely weak correlation with the economic benefit index, indicating that the current economic growth and social welfare improvement of the industry mainly rely on capital investment and scale expansion, and are relatively "decoupled" from the process of ecological environment improvement. The obstacle factor analysis results indicate that low production efficiency per unit water volume is the primary bottleneck restricting benefit improvement; wastewater discharge from direct-discharge pollution sources is the main ecological constraint; simultaneously, there are capacity shortcomings in supervision and technological support systems. Based on these findings, this paper proposes that future policies should focus on implementing precision management based on ecological carrying capacity, strengthening whole-chain technological support and coordinated pollution prevention and control, and promoting industrial integration and innovation, to foster high-quality, sustainable, and resilient development of offshore aquaculture.

AI.tldr: 本研究定量评估了中国2008-2022年离岸水产养殖的综合效益，发现其呈现显著上升趋势，经历了"波动探索→稳步恢复→加速增长"三个阶段。社会效益与经济效益呈强正相关，但生态效益与其他效益关联较弱，表明当前增长主要依赖资本投入和规模扩张，与生态环境改善相对"脱钩"。主要障碍包括单位水体生产效率低、直接排放污染源废水、监管和技术支持能力不足。
AI.research_question: 中国离岸水产养殖的综合效益如何？其发展面临哪些主要障碍？
AI.motivation: 随着海洋资源开发和环境保护需求的增加，需要科学评估离岸水产养殖的综合效益，识别发展瓶颈，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可持续发展理论，构建涵盖生态、社会、经济三个维度的综合效益评价指标体系。
AI.method: 采用CRITIC赋权法、多指标综合评价模型、Pearson相关系数和障碍度模型进行测量分析。
AI.findings: 1. 综合效益显著上升，经历三个阶段演变；2. 社会效益与经济效益呈强正相关(r≈0.815)，形成协同增强机制；3. 生态效益与社会、经济效益关联较弱，呈现"脱钩"现象；4. 主要障碍包括单位水体生产效率低、直接排放污染源废水、监管和技术支持能力不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了离岸水产养殖综合效益评价指标体系；2. 揭示了生态、社会、经济效益之间的关联特征和"脱钩"现象；3. 提出了离岸水产养殖发展的障碍因素分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供基于生态承载力的精准管理建议；2. 提出强化全链条技术支持和协同污染防治的具体措施；3. 建议推动产业融合创新，促进离岸水产养殖高质量、可持续、韧性发展。

title: The Impact of Organizational Characteristics on Talent Attraction in Enterprises: Focusing on the New Energy Vehicle Industry
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Pukyong National University

detail.title: The Impact of Organizational Characteristics on Talent Attraction in Enterprises: Focusing on the New Energy Vehicle Industry
detail.abstract: This study investigates how organizational characteristics shape talent attractiveness in the new energy vehicle (NEV) industry. Drawing on tool-symbol theory, person–organization fit theory, and trait activation theory, we develop and test an integrated framework using survey data and structural equation modeling. The results show that compensation, organizational reputation, and career development opportunities exert the strongest positive effects on talent attractiveness. Organizational identification and job satisfaction partially mediate these relationships, while geographical location strengthens them. This study contributes to the talent attraction literature by uncovering underlying mechanisms and offers managerial implications for firms in emerging industries.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨新能源汽车行业组织特征如何影响人才吸引力，基于工具-符号理论、人-组织匹配理论和特质激活理论构建整合框架，发现薪酬、组织声誉和职业发展机会对人才吸引力有最强正向影响，组织认同和工作满意度起部分中介作用，地理位置起调节作用。
AI.research_question: 新能源汽车行业的组织特征如何影响人才吸引力？
AI.motivation: 新兴行业（如新能源汽车）面临激烈的人才竞争，了解哪些组织特征能有效吸引人才对行业发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工具-符号理论、人-组织匹配理论、特质激活理论
AI.method: 问卷调查数据和结构方程模型分析
AI.findings: 薪酬、组织声誉和职业发展机会对人才吸引力有最强正向影响；组织认同和工作满意度起部分中介作用；地理位置起调节作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）整合多个理论构建人才吸引力框架；2）揭示组织特征影响人才吸引力的内在机制（中介作用）；3）识别调节因素（地理位置）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为新能源汽车企业提供人才吸引策略建议；2）强调薪酬、声誉和职业发展的重要性；3）考虑地理位置在人才吸引中的作用。

title: A lithium battery health state estimation approach based on SHAP-guided feature fusion and a diffusion model
affiliations: Shanghai Polytechnic University, Yancheng Institute of Technology, Shanghai Polytechnic University, Shanghai Polytechnic University, Shanghai Polytechnic University, Drexel University and Shanghai Polytechnic University

detail.title: A lithium battery health state estimation approach based on SHAP-guided feature fusion and a diffusion model
detail.abstract: Accurate and interpretable estimation of lithium-ion battery state of health (SOH) is essential for ensuring the safety and reliability of energy storage systems. However, existing data-driven approaches often suffer from degraded performance under small-sample conditions and provide limited insight into how predictions are made when processing raw sensor signals. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel end-to-end SOH estimation framework that synergistically combines a hybrid iTransformer–BiGRU architecture, diffusion-based data augmentation, and SHAP-guided interpretability analysis. The model takes raw voltage, current, and temperature time-series sequences as direct input, bypassing manual feature engineering. The iTransformer module captures long-range temporal correlations across cycles, while the BiGRU network models local degradation dynamics within each cycle, enabling comprehensive representation learning. To mitigate severe data scarcity—especially in batteries with few aging cycles—a denoising diffusion probabilistic model is employed to synthesize realistic multivariate time-series trajectories, effectively expanding the training set while preserving underlying degradation patterns. The Kepler Optimization Algorithm (KOA) is further integrated to automatically tune key hyperparameters of the prediction network for optimal performance. To enhance transparency, Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) are applied post-hoc to the trained model, quantifying the contribution of individual time steps and sensor channels to the final SOH prediction. This provides actionable insights into which segments of the charge/discharge profile (e.g., constant-current phase, relaxation period) are most informative for health assessment. Experimental validation on the NASA battery dataset demonstrates that the proposed method achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.0014 (i.e., 0.14% of nominal capacity) and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 0.0018, outperforming several state-of-the-art benchmarks. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of both diffusion-based augmentation and the iTransformer–BiGRU backbone, while SHAP analysis reveals consistent attention to physically plausible degradation signatures. This work thus delivers a high-accuracy, data-efficient, and inherently interpretable solution for real-world battery health monitoring—even when only raw sensor data and limited cycling history are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的端到端锂离子电池健康状态(SOH)估计框架，结合了混合iTransformer-BiGRU架构、基于扩散的数据增强和SHAP引导的可解释性分析，在数据稀缺条件下实现了高精度且可解释的SOH预测。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据稀缺条件下，基于原始传感器信号实现高精度且可解释的锂离子电池健康状态(SOH)估计？
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动方法在小样本条件下性能下降，且在处理原始传感器信号时预测过程缺乏可解释性，这限制了电池健康监测系统在实际应用中的安全性和可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 混合深度学习架构理论：iTransformer用于捕获跨周期的长程时间相关性，BiGRU用于建模每个周期内的局部退化动态；2) 扩散概率模型理论：用于数据增强以缓解数据稀缺问题；3) 可解释性理论：SHAP方法用于量化各时间步和传感器通道对SOH预测的贡献。
AI.method: 提出端到端SOH估计框架，包括：1) 混合iTransformer-BiGRU架构处理原始电压、电流和温度时间序列；2) 使用去噪扩散概率模型合成多元时间序列轨迹进行数据增强；3) 集成开普勒优化算法自动调优超参数；4) 应用SHAP进行后验可解释性分析。
AI.findings: 在NASA电池数据集上验证，该方法达到MAE 0.0014（即标称容量的0.14%）和RMSE 0.0018，优于多个最先进基准。消融研究证实了扩散增强和iTransformer-BiGRU骨干的有效性，SHAP分析显示模型关注物理上合理的退化特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一种新颖的混合深度学习架构，结合了全局和局部时间模式建模能力；2) 将扩散模型应用于电池数据增强，解决了小样本学习问题；3) 建立了基于SHAP的电池SOH预测可解释性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了一种高精度、数据高效且可解释的电池健康监测解决方案；2) 即使在原始传感器数据和有限循环历史条件下也能有效工作；3) 识别了充放电曲线中对健康评估最关键的阶段（如恒流阶段、弛豫期）。

title: Socioeconomic and Political Pathways to Achieving Environmental Sustainability in China
affiliations: Bahauddin Zakariya University

detail.title: Socioeconomic and Political Pathways to Achieving Environmental Sustainability in China
detail.abstract: The emphasis on environmental sustainability outcomes (ESO) in emerging economies has increased recently, requiring in-depth research to manage the complex interplay between socio-economic and sociopolitical factors. With a particular focus on China, this study describes this significant relationship using a good technique that comprises standardized questionnaires administered to a large sample of different organizational levels. This research examined several factors and their effects on ESO. First, the results show that the kind of economic system (EST) directly affects ESO; no direct relationship was discovered between ESO and the industrialization level (LI). Furthermore, it was demonstrated that government funding for eco-sustainability projects (GFESP) and community engagement and eco-education initiatives (CEEEI) had a direct impact on ESO.  Secondly, the results demonstrated that implementing eco-policies and regulations (IEPR) had a full mediating effect between EST and ESO. Third, political instability (PI) and corruption level (CL), which are essentially the outcome of China's current political and environmental issues, diminish the correlation between EST and ESO. These findings demonstrate that China's environmental sustainability has to be improved using a multimodal approach. The public is encouraged to push legislators to bolster eco-laws and policies in order to emphasize environmental preservation. Initiatives to reduce corruption and maintain political stability may also bolster the beneficial effects of economic frameworks on ESO.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了中国背景下经济体系类型、工业化水平、政府资助、社区参与等因素对环境可持续性成果的影响，发现经济体系直接影响ESO，而环保政策实施在两者间起完全中介作用，政治不稳定和腐败则会削弱这种关系。
AI.research_question: 在中国背景下，社会经济和社会政治因素如何影响环境可持续性成果？具体而言，经济体系类型、工业化水平、政府资助、社区参与等因素与环境可持续性成果之间的关系是什么？
AI.motivation: 新兴经济体对环境可持续性成果的重视日益增加，需要深入研究社会经济和社会政治因素之间的复杂相互作用。中国作为重要新兴经济体，其环境可持续性问题具有特殊研究价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该研究基于环境可持续性理论、制度理论和社会政治因素理论，探讨经济体系、政府政策、社区参与等制度因素对环境成果的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用标准化问卷调查方法，对中国不同组织层次的大样本进行调查，通过统计分析检验各因素与环境可持续性成果之间的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 经济体系类型直接影响环境可持续性成果；2. 工业化水平与环境可持续性成果无直接关系；3. 政府资助和社区参与直接影响环境可持续性成果；4. 环保政策实施在经济体系与环境可持续性成果之间起完全中介作用；5. 政治不稳定和腐败会削弱经济体系对环境可持续性成果的正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了经济体系通过环保政策实施影响环境可持续性成果的完整中介机制；2. 明确了政治不稳定和腐败作为调节变量的作用；3. 丰富了新兴经济体环境可持续性研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议中国采用多模式方法改善环境可持续性；2. 鼓励公众推动立法者加强环保法律和政策；3. 提出减少腐败和维护政治稳定的措施以增强经济框架对环境可持续性的积极影响。

title: Boundary neuron method for solving partial differential equations
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Texas State University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Boundary neuron method for solving partial differential equations
detail.abstract: We propose a boundary neuron method with random features (BNM-RF) for solving partial differential equations. The method approximates the unknown boundary function by a shallow network within the boundary integral formulation. With randomly sampled and fixed hidden parameters, the computation reduces to a linear least squares problem for the output coefficients, which avoids gradient based nonconvex optimization. This construction retains the dimensionality reduction of boundary integral equations and the linear solution structure of the random feature method. For elliptic problems, we establish convergence analysis by combining kernel-based method with random feature approximation, and obtain error bounds on both the boundary and the interior solution. Numerical experiments on Laplace and Helmholtz problems, including interior and exterior cases, show that the proposed method achieves competitive accuracy relative to the boundary element method and favorable performance relative to boundary integral neural networks in the tested settings with only few neurons. Overall, the proposed method provides a practical framework for combining boundary integral equations with neural network for problems on complex geometries and unbounded domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合边界积分方程与随机特征的边界神经元方法（BNM-RF），用于求解偏微分方程。该方法在边界积分公式中使用浅层网络近似未知边界函数，通过固定随机隐藏参数将计算简化为线性最小二乘问题，避免了基于梯度的非凸优化。该方法保持了边界积分方程的维度降低优势和随机特征方法的线性求解结构。
AI.research_question: 如何有效地结合边界积分方程与神经网络方法，在保持边界积分维度降低优势的同时，避免神经网络训练中的非凸优化问题？
AI.motivation: 边界积分方程能有效降低问题维度，适用于复杂几何和无界域问题；神经网络具有强大的逼近能力。但传统边界积分神经网络需要非凸优化，计算复杂。需要一种既能结合两者优势，又能简化计算的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 边界积分方程理论、随机特征方法、核方法、浅层神经网络逼近理论
AI.method: 边界神经元方法结合随机特征（BNM-RF）：在边界积分公式中使用浅层网络近似未知边界函数，随机采样并固定隐藏参数，将问题转化为线性最小二乘问题求解输出系数
AI.findings: 对于椭圆问题，建立了结合核方法与随机特征近似的收敛分析，获得了边界和内部解的误差界。数值实验（Laplace和Helmholtz问题，包括内部和外部情况）表明，该方法仅需少量神经元就能达到与边界元法相当的精度，且在测试设置中相对于边界积分神经网络具有更好的性能
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合边界积分方程与随机特征方法的理论框架；2. 建立了椭圆问题的收敛分析和误差界；3. 证明了该方法能保持边界积分方程的维度降低优势
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一种实用的计算框架，适用于复杂几何和无界域问题；2. 避免了神经网络训练中的非凸优化问题，计算更简单；3. 仅需少量神经元就能获得竞争性精度，计算效率高

title: Evolution Characteristics and Prediction Analysis of Runoff in Middle and Lower Reaches of Yellow River
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Anhui Agricultural University, Guizhou Institute of Technology, Anhui Agricultural University, Nanjing Hydraulic Research Institute and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Evolution Characteristics and Prediction Analysis of Runoff in Middle and Lower Reaches of Yellow River
detail.abstract: Water disasters with uncertainties are an important factor restricting the economic development of ecologically fragile areas. Although clarifying the evolution laws of runoff in a mainstream is theoretically effective for interpreting prediction results, few related efforts have been implemented. This study adopted multiple statistical methods to analyze the evolution characteristics of runoff of three typical stations in the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River of China, which represent different geographical and flow patterns. On this basis, the hydrological indicators at the three stations and environmental factors, such as soil moisture content, were utilized as input variables to predict the changing trend of runoff. The daily monitoring data from 2009 to 2022 was split into three parts to train, validate, and test the model at a ratio of 6:2:2. A hybrid prediction model BC-BiLSTM composed of the convolutional neural network (CNN) and bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) with the Bayesian optimization (BO) was proposed to deal with long time series runoff samples with various forms of variation. Compared with other models, the BC-BiLSTM performed better in terms of evaluation criteria of MSE, MAE, and R2. The annual runoff showed an overall upward trend, but a sudden change occurred in 2017 and 2018. Quarterly runoff follows periodic patterns with multiple characteristic scales, among which the wet and dry periods are evenly distributed. Although the prediction accuracy of long-lasting low flow events has slightly declined, the information features of the time series parts containing these events were all basically captured. The evolution characteristics and permutation analysis jointly reveal that 7d-Runoff logically explained regular variations of runoff based on its self-correlation information of multistage delay. The universal importance of W-level and Sedi-Conc with runoff suggests that the fragile soil structure with degraded vegetation is a main cause of irregular runoff events. The importance of Soil-MC at the San Menxia Station indicates that the sensitivity of the soil environment to runoff is amplified when the natural fluctuations of runoff decrease. This study demonstrates that both the natural environment and human activities have a significant influence on the evolution characteristics of runoff in this basin. The permutation analysis of input variables provides the possibility for interpreting the dynamic response rules of diverse runoff forms predicted by the BC-BiLSTM model.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用CNN-BiLSTM混合模型预测黄河中下游径流变化，发现径流呈上升趋势但存在突变，揭示了土壤结构和人类活动对径流演变的重要影响。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测黄河中下游径流变化趋势？哪些环境因素对径流演变具有重要影响？
AI.motivation: 水灾害不确定性制约生态脆弱区经济发展，但缺乏对径流演变规律的系统研究，需要开发有效的预测方法来解释径流变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于时间序列分析、深度学习理论（CNN、BiLSTM）、贝叶斯优化算法，结合水文统计学和环境科学理论。
AI.method: 采用多种统计方法分析径流演变特征，提出BC-BiLSTM混合预测模型（CNN+BiLSTM+贝叶斯优化），使用2009-2022年日监测数据按6:2:2比例划分训练集、验证集和测试集。
AI.findings: 1. BC-BiLSTM模型在MSE、MAE、R2评价指标上优于其他模型；2. 年径流总体呈上升趋势，2017-2018年发生突变；3. 季度径流呈现周期性特征；4. 7d-Runoff能解释径流规律变化；5. 土壤结构和植被退化是不规则径流事件的主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了结合CNN、BiLSTM和贝叶斯优化的混合预测模型；2. 揭示了径流演变的多尺度特征和突变规律；3. 建立了径流与环境因素的动态响应关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为黄河中下游径流预测提供了有效工具；2. 识别了影响径流的关键环境因素；3. 为生态脆弱区水资源管理和灾害防治提供决策支持；4. 模型可解释性有助于理解径流变化机制。

title: Modelling and Validating the Interrelationships among Barriers to Financial Inclusion of Internal Migrant Labours: An Integrated ISM-MICMAC and SEM Approach
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Modelling and Validating the Interrelationships among Barriers to Financial Inclusion of Internal Migrant Labours: An Integrated ISM-MICMAC and SEM Approach
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to identify and investigate the contextual relationships of the key barriers to internal migrant labours' financial inclusion. Using the interpretative structural modeling (ISM) approach, the barriers' contextual relations and hierarchies are formed, and they have been categorized into several categories using MICMAC analysis. Furthermore, the ISM model has been statistically validated using data gathered from a questionnaire-based study of internal migrant labourers using structural equation modelling based on partial least squares (PLS-SEM). The paper creates a structural model by developing relationships and imposing directions among the barriers.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用解释性结构建模(ISM)和MICMAC分析识别了内部移民工人金融包容性的关键障碍及其层次关系，并通过PLS-SEM进行了统计验证。
AI.research_question: 内部移民工人金融包容性的关键障碍是什么？这些障碍之间存在怎样的上下文关系和层次结构？
AI.motivation: 内部移民工人面临金融排斥问题，但现有研究缺乏对这些障碍系统性关系的深入理解，需要识别关键障碍及其相互关系以制定有效干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融包容性理论、移民研究理论、解释性结构建模(ISM)理论、MICMAC分析理论、结构方程模型理论
AI.method: 采用解释性结构建模(ISM)方法构建障碍的上下文关系和层次结构，使用MICMAC分析对障碍进行分类，并通过基于偏最小二乘的结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)对ISM模型进行统计验证，数据来自对内部移民工人的问卷调查。
AI.findings: 识别了内部移民工人金融包容性的关键障碍，建立了障碍之间的层次关系结构，将障碍分类为不同类别，并通过统计验证确认了障碍间关系的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融包容性研究提供了系统性分析框架，扩展了ISM和MICMAC方法在移民金融研究中的应用，深化了对障碍间复杂关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别关键干预点的结构化模型，帮助设计针对性的金融包容性项目，为金融机构开发适合移民工人的金融产品提供指导。

title: What Drives Crypto Prices?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University, Johns Hopkins University and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: What Drives Crypto Prices?
detail.abstract: We study intraday price discovery in cryptocurrency markets using high-frequency session-level data across global trading zones over March 2024–March 2026. We identify two primary and distinct drivers of crypto price variation. First, the Amihud (2002) illiquidity ratio explains up to 70\% of the magnitude of intraday price movements during the New York morning session (9 AM–12 PM ET), with higher illiquidity systematically associated with larger absolute price changes. This result is robust across most global sessions. However, the illiquidity channel predicts the size of price moves, not their direction. Second, changes in stablecoin prices during the European lunch session (7 AM–9 AM ET) explain up to 90\% of crypto price variation in the subsequent New York morning (9 AM - 12 PM ET) and lunch (12 PM–1 PM ET) sessions. This stablecoin channel is concentrated in price deviations from the dollar peg: using two-stage least squares (2SLS), we show that stablecoin volume carries no predictive power once instrumented, while price deviations retain strong and statistically significant predictive content. Stablecoin-driven predictability dissipates sharply during New York afternoon trading hours, consistent with the influx of informed institutional investors actively rebalancing their portfolios and ETFs. Our findings carry direct implications for financial stability: regulators should focus surveillance on intraday stablecoin price deviations as an early-warning indicator, rather than on volume-based metrics alone. The time-zone asymmetry in predictability further calls for internationally coordinated, session-aware oversight of stablecoin markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2024年3月至2026年3月的高频数据，发现加密货币日内价格发现的两个主要驱动因素：1) Amihud非流动性比率解释了纽约早盘价格变动幅度的70%；2) 欧洲午餐时段稳定币价格偏离美元锚定解释了后续纽约时段90%的价格变动。稳定币驱动的可预测性在纽约下午时段消失，表明机构投资者参与提高了市场效率。
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场的日内价格发现机制是什么？哪些因素驱动加密货币的日内价格变动？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场在全球不同时区交易，但对其日内价格发现机制的理解有限。研究旨在识别加密货币价格变动的关键驱动因素，特别是关注不同交易时段和全球交易区域的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，特别是Amihud(2002)的非流动性理论，以及稳定币作为加密货币市场价值锚定的作用。研究还涉及信息不对称理论和机构投资者行为理论。
AI.method: 使用2024年3月至2026年3月的高频会话级别数据，覆盖全球交易区域。采用两阶段最小二乘法(2SLS)进行计量分析，将稳定币交易量作为工具变量，分离价格偏离美元锚定的影响。
AI.findings: 1) Amihud非流动性比率解释了纽约早盘价格变动幅度的70%，且在全球多数交易时段稳健；2) 欧洲午餐时段稳定币价格偏离美元锚定解释了后续纽约时段90%的价格变动；3) 稳定币驱动的可预测性在纽约下午时段消失，表明机构投资者参与提高了市场效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了加密货币市场日内价格发现的两个独立渠道：非流动性渠道和稳定币锚定偏离渠道；2) 揭示了稳定币价格偏离作为信息信号的重要性，而非交易量；3) 证明了机构投资者参与对市场效率的改善作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为监管机构提供早期预警指标：应关注稳定币日内价格偏离而非仅交易量；2) 呼吁国际协调的、时段感知的稳定币市场监管；3) 为投资者提供交易策略参考，特别是关注欧洲午餐时段的稳定币价格信号。

title: Phase transformation in oxygen pressure leaching of high-lead zinc concentrates for residue reduction and efficiency leaching
affiliations: Honghe University, Honghe University, Honghe University, Kunming University of Science and Technology - Faculty of Metallurgical and Energy Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology - Faculty of Metallurgical and Energy Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology - Faculty of Metallurgical and Energy Engineering and Kunming University of Science and Technology - Faculty of Metallurgical and Energy Engineering

detail.title: Phase transformation in oxygen pressure leaching of high-lead zinc concentrates for residue reduction and efficiency leaching
detail.abstract: The effective recovery of zinc and other valuable metals from high-Pb zinc sulfide concentrates remains challenging owing to lead jarosite (Pb-J) formation during oxygen pressure leaching. This hazardous waste byproduct hinders metal extraction and significantly increases the yield of leach residues. This study employs a two-stage oxygen pressure leaching process (LHPL) with a "low-temperature reduction followed by high-temperature oxidation" control strategy to selectively regulate iron leaching and suppress Pb-J phase formation. Compared with the two-stage high-pressure high-temperature leaching process (HHPL), the LHPL process increased the leaching efficiencies of zinc, copper, and indium from 96.7%, 65.2%, and 68.9% to 98.6%, 88.3%, and 90.1%, silver enrichment rate improved from 72.0% to 93.1%, and reduce residue yield by 20%, which effectively minimizes residue generation at the source. Mineralogical analysis reveals that the LHPL process stably converts lead into PbSO4 rather than Pb-J. The LHPL residue exhibits a coarser particle size and hydrophobic surface, leading to excellent settling performance and efficient solid–liquid separation, while the process maintains Fe2+ in the first stage to facilitate iron removal and retains soluble Fe3+ in the second stage to accelerate leaching. This approach suppresses Pb-J formation and maximizes iron utilization. These findings provide technical guidance for the reduction of hazardous iron-containing residues.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出一种两段式氧压浸出工艺（LHPL），采用"低温还原后高温氧化"控制策略，有效抑制铅黄钾铁矾形成，提高锌、铜、铟浸出率，减少浸出渣产量，实现危险含铁废渣的源头减量。
AI.research_question: 如何通过工艺优化抑制铅黄钾铁矾形成，提高高铅锌硫化精矿中锌及其他有价金属的浸出效率，并减少危险废渣产生？
AI.motivation: 传统氧压浸出过程中铅黄钾铁矾的形成阻碍金属提取，显著增加浸出渣产量，造成资源浪费和环境污染，亟需开发有效的抑制方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于铁浸出选择性调控理论，通过控制浸出过程中的氧化还原条件（Fe2+/Fe3+平衡）和温度策略，抑制铅黄钾铁矾相形成，促进铅转化为更稳定的PbSO4。
AI.method: 采用两段式氧压浸出工艺（LHPL），实施"低温还原后高温氧化"控制策略，与传统的两段高温高压浸出工艺（HHPL）进行对比实验，通过矿物学分析和性能测试评估工艺效果。
AI.findings: LHPL工艺将锌、铜、铟浸出率分别从96.7%、65.2%、68.9%提高到98.6%、88.3%、90.1%，银富集率从72.0%提升至93.1%，浸出渣产量减少20%，铅稳定转化为PbSO4而非铅黄钾铁矾，渣相具有更粗颗粒和疏水表面，沉降性能优异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过控制铁浸出选择性来抑制铅黄钾铁矾形成的理论机制，阐明了Fe2+/Fe3+平衡在浸出过程中的关键作用，为类似含铁危险废渣的源头减量提供了理论指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一种高效的两段式氧压浸出工艺，实现了有价金属的高效回收和危险废渣的源头减量，为锌冶炼行业提供了可行的技术解决方案，具有显著的经济和环境效益。

title: Tariffs across the supply chain
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank and Central Bank of Malta

detail.title: Tariffs across the supply chain
detail.abstract: What are the macroeconomic impacts of tariffs on final goods versus intermediate inputs? We set up a two-region, multi-sector model with global production networks, sticky prices and wages, and trade in consumption, investment, and intermediate goods. We show, analytically and quantitatively, that import tariffs on final goods have a smaller negative impact on GDP compared to tariffs on intermediate inputs, as final goods can be more readily substituted domestically. By contrast, tariffs on intermediate inputs lead to larger GDP losses, given the limited substitutability of foreign inputs. Moreover, inflation persistence is lower under tariffs on final goods, whereas tariffs on intermediate goods give rise to persistent cost pressures through production linkages. The results imply that revenue-equivalent import tariffs targeting only final goods can cushion the adverse effects of trade fragmentation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过建立包含全球生产网络的两区域多部门模型，分析最终品关税与中间品关税对宏观经济的不同影响。研究发现，最终品关税对GDP的负面影响较小且通胀持续性较低，而中间品关税会导致更大的GDP损失和持续的成本压力。
AI.research_question: 最终品关税与中间品关税对宏观经济（特别是GDP和通胀）的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 在贸易碎片化背景下，理解不同类型关税的宏观经济效应对于政策制定至关重要。最终品和中间品在贸易和生产网络中的不同角色可能导致关税政策产生差异化的经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于两区域、多部门模型，包含全球生产网络、价格和工资粘性，以及消费、投资和中间品的贸易流动。
AI.method: 建立理论模型并进行解析和定量分析，比较最终品关税与中间品关税对GDP和通胀的不同影响机制。
AI.findings: 1. 最终品关税对GDP的负面影响较小，因为最终品更容易被国内产品替代；2. 中间品关税导致更大的GDP损失，因为外国中间品的替代性有限；3. 最终品关税下的通胀持续性较低；4. 中间品关税通过生产联系产生持续的成本压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在包含全球生产网络和价格粘性的模型中，系统分析了不同类型关税的宏观经济效应差异；2. 揭示了最终品与中间品在贸易政策传导机制中的不同作用；3. 为理解关税政策在复杂生产网络中的影响提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定者可以通过针对最终品的关税来减轻贸易碎片化的负面影响；2. 在制定关税政策时需要考虑目标商品类型（最终品vs中间品）的不同经济后果；3. 为实现特定政策目标（如保护国内产业vs控制通胀）提供了更精细的政策工具选择依据。

title: Multi-scale approach to understanding and predicting environmental reactivity in the context of ISR
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Mines Paris - PSL, Mines Paris - PSL, Université Paris-Dauphine, PSL Research University - MINES ParisTech, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Multi-scale approach to understanding and predicting environmental reactivity in the context of ISR
detail.abstract: In situ recovery (ISR) is a worldwide mining technique which accounts for more than 52 % (in 2024) of global U production, thanks to its cost-effectiveness. However, where an ISR process uses sulfuric acid (H2SO4), local underground exploited aquifers’ water quality can be affected by low pH and high concentrations of SO4. Hydrogeochemical processes controlling this groundwater changes are studied here in the context of the planned exploitation of the Zoovch Ovoo deposit in Mongolia, using a multi-scale approach comparing real data with models. At the laboratory scale, experimental data combined with a 1D reactive transport model (RTM) demonstrate that ion-exchange reactions on clay minerals surface are the main geochemical mechanism governing groundwater chemistry (pH and major ions). To consider system heterogeneity and the spatial impact of the ISR process, field data from two pilot cells were combined with a 3D reactive transport model. The model successfully reproduced the field data by considering both ion-exchange and dissolution-precipitation reactions of the mineral phases, especially calcite and gypsum, necessary to explain the water chemistry at larger scale. Vertical and lateral fluid excursions out of the pilot cells were observed depending on the system heterogeneity. This study demonstrated that the relative importance of the various processes investigated depends on the time and distance scales probed. For the short term and U production, heterogeneities and ion-exchange are crucial for explaining the changes in groundwater chemistry. A better understanding and quantification of these processes will help operators optimize production and long-term environmental remediation strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究采用多尺度方法分析了硫酸原地浸出（ISR）铀矿开采对地下水化学的影响机制，通过实验数据与反应输运模型相结合，揭示了离子交换和矿物溶解-沉淀反应在不同时空尺度上的主导作用。
AI.research_question: 硫酸原地浸出（ISR）铀矿开采过程中，控制地下水化学变化（低pH值和高SO4浓度）的主要水文地球化学过程是什么？这些过程在不同时空尺度上如何影响地下水质量？
AI.motivation: ISR技术占全球铀产量的52%以上，具有成本效益，但使用硫酸的ISR过程会降低地下水pH值并提高SO4浓度，影响当地含水层水质。需要深入了解控制这些变化的地球化学机制，以优化生产和环境修复策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水文地球化学理论，特别是离子交换反应（粘土矿物表面）和矿物溶解-沉淀反应（方解石、石膏等）对地下水化学组成的控制机制。采用多尺度建模方法，结合实验室和现场数据验证反应输运模型。
AI.method: 采用多尺度方法：1）实验室尺度：实验数据结合一维反应输运模型（RTM）；2）现场尺度：两个试验单元现场数据结合三维反应输运模型。比较真实数据与模型结果，分析系统异质性对流体运移的影响。
AI.findings: 1）实验室尺度：粘土矿物表面的离子交换反应是控制地下水化学（pH和主要离子）的主要机制；2）现场尺度：需要同时考虑离子交换和矿物溶解-沉淀反应（特别是方解石和石膏）才能解释大尺度水化学；3）流体在试验单元外的垂直和侧向运移受系统异质性影响；4）不同过程的相对重要性取决于探测的时间和距离尺度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）阐明了ISR过程中地下水化学变化的多尺度控制机制；2）证明了离子交换反应在短期铀生产中的关键作用；3）揭示了系统异质性对流体运移和反应过程的影响；4）建立了实验室与现场尺度的模型验证框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为ISR铀矿开采提供地下水化学变化预测工具；2）帮助运营商优化生产策略；3）指导长期环境修复方案设计；4）为蒙古Zoovch Ovoo矿床的规划开采提供科学依据。

title: Analysis of Billing Mechanisms for Equitable Energy Access in a Distributed Energy System
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Analysis of Billing Mechanisms for Equitable Energy Access in a Distributed Energy System
detail.abstract: The increasing deployment of distributed energy resources (DER) has accelerated the transition toward clean and sustainable energy systems, while raising concerns about equitable energy access among heterogeneous consumers. In distributed energy systems (DES), the distribution of economic benefits is determined by pricing mechanisms such as Net Energy Metering (NEM) and Feed-in Tariff (FiT). While these mechanisms have been extensively studied for renewable energy integration and economic efficiency, their effects on surplus distribution and equity remain underexplored. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic analytical framework to evaluate the surplus distribution and equity impacts of NEM and FiT in DES. The analysis explicitly links pricing mechanism design to individual consumer net benefits and equitable energy access. It assesses distributional outcomes using a Rawlsian equity criterion that prioritizes improvements for the least-advantaged participants. Case-wise comparative analysis is conducted to identify conditions under which NEM or FiT leads to more equitable outcomes, supported by numerical validation on a standard IEEE PES open dataset. The results highlight inherent trade-offs between efficiency and equity and provide analytical insights to support the design of pricing mechanisms that promote fair, affordable, and sustainable DES.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个系统分析框架，评估分布式能源系统中净计量电价(NEM)和上网电价(FiT)对剩余分配和公平性的影响，揭示效率与公平之间的权衡，为促进公平、可负担和可持续的分布式能源系统定价机制设计提供见解。
AI.research_question: 分布式能源系统中，净计量电价(NEM)和上网电价(FiT)这两种定价机制如何影响剩余分配和能源公平性？在什么条件下NEM或FiT能带来更公平的结果？
AI.motivation: 分布式能源资源的部署加速了清洁能源转型，但引发了不同消费者之间能源获取公平性的担忧。现有研究主要关注可再生能源整合和经济效率，而对定价机制在剩余分配和公平性方面的影响研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于罗尔斯公平准则，优先考虑最弱势参与者的改善；将定价机制设计与个体消费者净收益和公平能源获取明确联系起来。
AI.method: 建立了系统分析框架，进行案例比较分析，识别NEM或FiT带来更公平结果的条件，并使用标准IEEE PES开放数据集进行数值验证。
AI.findings: 揭示了效率与公平之间的内在权衡关系；识别了NEM或FiT在不同条件下对公平性的具体影响；为定价机制设计提供了分析见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估分布式能源系统定价机制公平影响的系统分析框架；将罗尔斯公平准则应用于能源定价机制评估；建立了定价机制设计与个体消费者福利和公平能源获取之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和能源系统设计者提供了设计促进公平、可负担和可持续分布式能源系统的定价机制的具体指导；识别了不同定价机制在不同条件下的公平性表现；支持更公平的能源转型政策制定。

title: Hydropower Uncertainty in Capacity Expansion: Calibration Against a Hydro-Thermal Scheduling Model
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Canterbury, University of Auckland and University of Canterbury

detail.title: Hydropower Uncertainty in Capacity Expansion: Calibration Against a Hydro-Thermal Scheduling Model
detail.abstract: The global transition to a zero-carbon energy system requires modelling tools that translate decarbonisation targets into actionable investment and operational strategies. Hydropower’s operational flexibility is essential for integrating variable renewables, yet many capacity expansion models (CEMs) rely on deterministic, perfect-foresight assumptions, which can misrepresent system flexibility and produce unrealistic dispatch patterns. We present a model validation framework to evaluate whether a reduced-order hydro uncertainty formulation provides a faithful approximation to stochastic hydro-thermal operational model. GEMSTONE, a two-stage stochastic capacity expansion model with scenario-dependent availability factors and end-of-season storage-gates, is benchmarked against JADE, a high-fidelity SDDP-based hydro-thermal scheduling model, across a range of representative inflow scenarios. Results demonstrate that the storage-gate formulation closely replicates total system operating costs (within [[EQUATION]]) but suppress scenario-specific operational decisions to approximate uncertainty and maintain non-anticipativity.
